AI.result: 预研：所有受测网页增强LLM均受SII影响；平均每新增1个正确解就伴随73%的新增错误。商用模型NIR：GPT-Search 73.91%（+23/−17）、Claude-Search 37.50%、Gemini-Search 71.43%；开源实现：GPT-4o 78.13%、DeepSeek-V3 94.12%、Claude 3.7 Sonnet 32.35%、Gemini 2.5 Flash 78.13%、o4-mini 91.67%（新增48题正确却新增44题错误）、DeepSeek-R1 100%。根因分布（93页/40实例）：21.5%规格对齐且实现正确，9.7%规格对齐但实现错误，68.8%规格错配；且无一实例中三张检索页全部合规，说明"提供相关且正确的内容"可显著降险，而单张错配页即足以致错。Sherlock：EIP检测F1为93.10%/93.81%/93.88%/94.02%/95.52%（Precision最高98.15%，Recall最高94.12%）；242个真值EIP中诊断加权准确率90.91%（规格诊断188/205=91.71%，实现诊断32/37=86.49%）；对220个已诊断EIP的缓存修改人工复核，修复准确率93.64%（206/220），失败者集中于边界模糊的规格错配。修复效果：六个模型在五基准上修复71%–100%的SII任务（如GPT-4o在DevEval 171/185、LiveCodeBench 99/114）。与基线对比：Sherlock在全部90个"模型×基准×Top-k"设置最优，宏平均修复率Top-3/5/10为87.02%/87.02%/81.63%，最强基线RA-RAG仅46.68%/46.25%/43.62%，Self-RAG与RankGPT更低，宏平均高出最高80.1%；检索深度增至Top-10时性能下降（30个模型-基准对中26个变差），反映开放网页中低质/过时/语境错配页面随深度增加而累积；与RA-RAG组合后进一步提升，LiveCodeBench达94.74%/94.26%/93.94%，DevEval达95.68%/94.79%/93.10%，说明源头修复与反应式缓解互补。安全性：107个被多任务引用的页面中修复83个、涉及96个原本正确的任务，修复未使任何原正确任务退化。效率：调试阶段平均2.94s/例（利用检测0.41s、诊断2.53s，其中规格对齐2.49s主要源于LLM API延迟，实现检查仅0.04s），修复阶段<0.01s，总体约2.95s/例。局限：MBPP+ Task 161等案例显示其依赖代码级相似度，难以察觉与类型语义/使用约束相关的隐性规格错配（隐含可哈希假设），失败需引入类型感知静态分析或约束推理。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统研究网页增强LLM代码生成中的搜索诱导问题（SII），证明其在商用与开源系统中普遍存在（每修复1题平均新增73%错误），并从人工标注中提炼出EIP的两类根因——规格错配（约68.8%）与实现错误（约9.7%），指出基础性可评测代码构件是防御的高杠杆切入点。据此提出面向LLM服务提供商的主动式、缓存级自动化防御框架Sherlock：通过与基线生成对比检测SII，多粒度相似度+LLM智能体+测试执行定位EIP并判定根因，再以"替换缺陷代码片段"或"注入结构化元数据"两种策略修复缓存，实现"修一次、护万端"的源头治理。Sherlock能以最高95%的F1识别EIP、90.9%准确率诊断根因、修复71%–100%的受影响生成，显著优于三种代表性反应式RAG基线且与其互补，同时不引入跨任务回归，额外开销约2.95秒/例，可无缝嵌入生产质量保障流水线。作者同时明确指出了方法边界（隐性规格错配、依赖Correctness Evaluator质量）与未来方向（冗余验证的评估器、更广领域基准、多模态网页、与漏洞检测修复技术结合），并强调Sherlock与推理时防御是正交互补的第二道防线。

title: ReCUBE: Evaluating Repository-Level Context Utilization in Code Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently emerged as capable coding assistants that operate over large codebases through either agentic exploration or full-context generation. Existing benchmarks capture a broad range of coding capabilities, such as resolving GitHub issues, but none of them directly isolate and measure how effectively LLMs leverage repository-level context during code generation. To address this, we introduce ReCUBE, a benchmark in which LLMs reconstruct a masked file within a real-world repository, using all remaining source files, dependency specifications, and documentation as their only source of context. ReCUBE evaluates reconstructed code with usage-aware test cases that simulate both internal module logic and external cross-file integration, reflecting real-world software usage patterns. We further propose the Caller-Centric Exploration (CCE) toolkit, a set of dependency graph-based tools that can be integrated into agentic frameworks to guide agents toward the most relevant caller files during repository exploration. Experiments across eight models in four settings show that repository-level context utilization remains highly challenging even for state-of-the-art models, with GPT-5 achieving only 37.57% strict pass rate in the full-context setting. Agents augmented with our CCE toolkit consistently outperform all baselines across all evaluated models, with improvements of up to 7.56% in strict pass rate. We release our benchmark, code, and evaluation framework as open source for the NLP research community.

AI.tldr: ReCUBE 是一个面向大语言模型（LLM）"仓库级上下文利用能力"的代码生成基准：模型需仅依赖同一真实仓库中的其余源文件、依赖说明与文档，重建一个被"掩码"（删除全部 import、函数体替换为 raise NotImplementedError）的 Python 文件；配合 10,785 条 usage-aware 测试用例（58.7% 外部跨文件、41.3% 内部实现）进行严格评估，并提出基于依赖图的 Caller-Centric Exploration (CCE) 工具包。八个模型 × 四种设置的结果显示：即使是 GPT-5，在全上下文设置下严格通过率 (SPR) 也仅 37.57%，说明仓库级上下文利用对当前 SOTA 模型仍极具挑战；而加入 CCE 的智能体在所有模型与指标上一致最优，较全上下文最高提升 +5.79%（较朴素智能体 +7.56%），并在成本效率上同样占优。
AI.motivation: LLM 已从单函数补全转向整个仓库级别的软件开发（agentic 探索或全上下文生成），需要理解、导航并整合包含上千行、数十个文件相互依赖的代码。但现有基准（LiveCodeBench、SWEBench、Commit0、RepoBench-C、LocBench、LongBench v2、LongCodeBench、LoCoBench）要么依赖自然语言任务描述（如 SWE-Bench 的 issue/commit message），要么依赖跨文件依赖做下一行补全，要么是长上下文问答，均未隔离"模型在生成代码时到底多有效 地利用了仓库级上下文"；已有的代码定位（code localization）工作亦依赖自然语言而非仓库结构。因此社区缺少一个专门、直接度量"仓库级上下文利用能力"的评测框架。同时，朴素 agentic 探索受限于导航能力，往往无法定位到最相关的调用方文件，导致重建质量低。
AI.method: 【基准构建】(1) 仓库收集：GitHub 搜索 2025 年 1 月后创建（晚于基座模型最新知识截止）、≥10K star / ≥1K fork、宽松许可的 20 个高质量仓库；(2) 功能子集划分：人工审阅，将仓库拆为最多 8 个自包含功能子集，共 40 个（以 Python 为主，辅以 Dockerfile、YAML、Shell）；(3) 子集掩码：每子集选 ≤10 个核心 Python 文件，共 366 个目标文件，掩码方式为删除所有 import、函数体替换为 raise NotImplementedError，保留签名与 docstring；(4) 仓库级上下文 C = 掩码子集 + 环境依赖 D（PyPI 版本与完整项目描述）+ 文档 R（相关 Markdown），各部分用 XML 风格标签包裹。【任务与评测】分为 Full-Context（静态单轮提示）与 Agentic（Docker/Apptainer 容器化镜像原仓库目录结构）两类设置。测试用例由 Claude Opus 4.1 生成：要求分析 in-file 与 cross-file 调用模式、基于真实 caller/callee 生成 usage-aware 断言，在 Docker testbed 中验证在 gold 实现上通过，并替换平凡/不稳定测试；用例分为 external（验证公共 API 的跨文件集成，6,334 条）与 internal（验证私有实现逻辑，4,451 条），共 10,785 条。指标：严格通过率 SPR（全部用例通过才算对）与平均通过率 APR（按比例给部分功能分），对应 APPS 的 Strict Accuracy / Test Case Average。【CCE 工具包】将每个实例索引为异构有向图（节点：directory/file/class/function；边：contains/imports/invokes/inherits），并从图中移除目标文件以防信息泄漏。三个工具：① show_implementation_context——先验给出四类视角：Caller Patterns（谁调用/导入目标及其调用频率）、Inheritance（类继承层次与同级实现）、Module Context（目录组织与邻居文件的共享 import）、Similar Files（文件名子词重叠 + AST 提取的类/函数数量与嵌套深度 + 代码标识符归一化 BM25 三路相似信号）；② 以内联 Python 脚本可编程查询依赖图（graph_helper 提供 find_usages、quick_search、get_file_content 等）；③ validate_code 语法与完整性校验（可捕获导致 0% 通过率的语法错误）。【实验】8 个模型（Claude 3 Haiku、Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro、GPT-5、GPT-5 Mini、GPT-OSS 20B、Devstral Small 2507、Qwen3-Coder 30B）× 4 种设置（Full-Context、Full-Context+CoT、Agent(bash-only，基于 mini SWE-agent)、Agent+CCE），并扩展 ReCUBE-large（同仓库子集合并，138 个实例，平均 146K、最大 338K tokens）。全部禁用 web_search 等内置工具以防数据污染。
AI.result: 【主结果】Full-Context 下 GPT-5 最佳（SPR 37.57、APR 60.43），GPT-5 Mini 33.43/54.02，Gemini 2.5 Pro 29.56/51.53，GPT-OSS 20B 25.07/36.83，Qwen3-Coder 30B 25.34/38.54，Gemini 2.5 Flash 25.69/40.28，Devstral Small 21.76/30.20，Claude 3 Haiku 18.66/23.17；小型开源模型已可比肩弱闭源模型。外部测试用例普遍比内部低约 9.55 SPR，说明"跨文件集成"比"自包含实现"难得多。【CoT】对 GPT-5（-0.28）、Devstral（-2.54）、Qwen3-Coder（-0.48）有害（占用上下文且收益缺失，GPT-5 自带内部推理轨迹），仅对 GPT-OSS 20B（+1.52）与 GPT-5 Mini（+0.55）有中等增益。【基础 Agent】收益随上下文窗口增大而衰减甚至反转：Devstral（131K）+2.06 SPR/+5.01 APR，Qwen3-Coder（256K）仅 +0.42/+0.40，GPT-5 Mini（400K）反而 -2.21/-3.46。【Agent+CCE】所有模型、所有指标上一致最优：GPT-5 Mini 达 38.78 SPR（较全上下文 +5.35，超过 GPT-5 的全上下文表现）、Devstral 25.76（+4.00）、Qwen3-Coder 28.45（+3.11）；相对全上下文最高 +5.79（GPT-5 Mini 外部 SPR）、内部 APR 最高 +8.24（Devstral），相对朴素 agent 最高 +7.56。【机制分析】caller coverage 与 APR 在困难档显著正相关（Kendall τ=+0.280、Spearman ρ=+0.404，p<0.05；Qwen3-Coder ρ=+0.408，p=0.035），而在简单档不显著；CCE 在所有难度分位上均提升 caller coverage，SPR 增益集中在 hard/hardest 档（bash-only 中 0% SPR 的最难实例提升最大），验证"caller-first"假设。【领域分析】LLM 服务（44.19 SPR）与 Agent 框架（36.23）最易，语音/语音处理等多模态任务最难。【大规模】ReCUBE-large 上 Devstral 全上下文崩溃（SPR 掉 >10%，39.13% 案例因超长上下文直接失败），agentic 可缓解；GPT-5 Mini 反而提升（Agent+CCE 达 57.72 APR，+1.58）。【成本效率】GPT-5-mini：原始规模 SPR/Cost 254.6→312.5、SPR/Turn 1.46→1.91；大规模 221.4→332.6、1.22→1.96，且轮数减少（21.35→20.30、25.66→19.81）、大规模时成本反而下降（$0.1410→$0.1166）。
AI.conclusion: ReCUBE 证明"仓库级上下文利用"是一个真实且未解决的瓶颈：即便 GPT-5 在信息齐备的全上下文条件下也仅 37.57% SPR，且在外部（跨文件集成）用例上普遍更弱，CoT 显式推理并非解法，朴素 agent 探索只在上下文紧张时有效。作者据此提出以调用方为中心的依赖图工具包 CCE，先验暴露 caller 模式、继承关系、模块上下文与相似文件，并支持图查询与语法校验；实验显示其在所有模型与设置上稳定最优，尤其在困难任务与大规模上下文（ReCUBE-large）下同时提升正确性与成本效率，说明"让 agent 先看清谁在调用我"是提升仓库级代码生成的有效路径。基准、代码、评测框架与 Docker 镜像均开源。局限：仓库来源偏向热门 AI/LLM 项目，领域覆盖较窄；实现语言严格限定 Python；全量评测成本高导致 agent 设置下覆盖模型数量有限；未来计划引入 OpenHands、SWE-agent 等更多框架。

title: Parameter-Free Dynamic Regret for Unconstrained Linear Bandits
summary: We study dynamic regret minimization in unconstrained adversarial linear bandit problems. In this setting, a learner must minimize the cumulative loss relative to an arbitrary sequence of comparators $\boldsymbol{u}_1,\ldots,\boldsymbol{u}_T$ in $\mathbb{R}^d$, but receives only point-evaluation feedback on each round. We provide a simple approach to combining the guarantees of several bandit algorithms, allowing us to optimally adapt to the number of switches $S_T = \sum_t\mathbb{I}\{\boldsymbol{u}_t \neq \boldsymbol{u}_{t-1}\}$ of an arbitrary comparator sequence. In particular, we provide the first algorithm for linear bandits achieving the optimal regret guarantee of order $\mathcal{O}\big(\sqrt{d(1+S_T) T}\big)$ up to poly-logarithmic terms without prior knowledge of $S_T$, thus resolving a long-standing open problem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对抗性线性老虎机中的动态遗憾最小化问题 Learner仅接收点评估反馈，需相对于任意比较器序列最小化累积损失。通过组合多个老虎机算法的保证，提出首个无需预先知道切换次数S_T即可达到最优O(√(d(1+S_T)T))遗憾界（至多多对数因子）的算法，解决了该领域的长期开放问题。
AI.motivation: 在线学习中的动态遗憾最小化是一个核心问题。在对抗性线性老虎机设置中，学习者需要相对于时变比较器序列优化性能，但仅能获得点评估反馈。现有方法难以在不知道切换次数的情况下实现最优自适应。
AI.method: 提出一种组合多种老虎机算法保证的简单方法，能够根据比较器序列的实际切换次数S_T自动调整算法性能。
AI.result: 首次在无需预先知道S_T的情况下，为线性老虎机问题实现了最优遗憾保证：O(√(d(1+S_T)T))（至多多对数因子）。
AI.conclusion: 解决了线性老虎机中动态遗憾最小化的长期开放问题，提供了首个在切换次数未知情况下达到最优自适应性能的理论保证。

title: SWE-PRBench: Benchmarking AI Code Review Quality Against Pull Request Feedback
summary: We introduce SWE-PRBench, a benchmark of 350 pull requests with human-annotated ground truth for evaluating AI code review quality. Evaluated against an LLM-as-judge framework validated at kappa=0.75, 8 frontier models detect only 15-31% of human-flagged issues on the diff-only configuration, demonstrating that AI code review remains far below human expert performance despite strong results on code generation benchmarks. Pull requests are drawn from active open-source repositories, filtered from 700 candidates using a Repository Quality Score, and evaluated under three frozen context configurations: diff only (config_A), diff with file content (config_B), and full context (config_C), enabling systematic ablation of context provision strategies. All 8 models degrade monotonically from config_A to config_C, even when context is provided via structured semantic layers including AST-extracted function context and import graph resolution. The dominant mechanism is a collapse of Type2_Contextual issue detection at config_B, consistent with attention dilution in long contexts: a structured 2,000-token diff-with-summary prompt outperforms a 2,500-token full-context prompt enriched with execution context, behaviour mapping, and test signatures across all 8 models. The top four models are statistically indistinguishable (mean score 0.147-0.153) while a clear tier gap separates them from the remaining four (mean score <= 0.113). Dataset, contexts, annotations, and evaluation harness are released publicly.

AI.tldr: SWE-PRBench是一个包含350个Pull Request的AI代码审查质量评估基准，8个前沿模型仅能检测15-31%的人工标注问题。更反直觉的是，增加上下文反而导致性能下降，2000 token的结构化摘要提示优于2500 token的完整上下文提示。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成基准表现强劲，但AI代码审查能力是否同样优秀尚不明确。缺乏标准化benchmark来系统评估AI在真实代码审查场景中的表现，特别是上下文信息对审查质量的影响机制。
AI.method: 从700个候选PR中筛选，提取高质量的350个PR；采用kappa=0.75验证的LLM-as-judge框架评估；在三种冻结上下文配置下进行系统消融：diff only、diff with file content、full context。
AI.result: 8个前沿模型在diff-only配置下仅检测15-31%的人类标记问题。所有模型从config_A到config_C单调下降。结构化2000-token diff+摘要提示优于2500-token完整上下文提示。Top4模型(0.147-0.153)与剩余4个模型(<=0.113)存在明显层级差距。
AI.conclusion: AI代码审查能力远低于人类专家水平。上下文增加导致Type2_Contextual问题检测崩溃，符合注意力稀释机制。提供结构化语义层（如摘要）比简单堆砌上下文更有效。

title: Preventing Data Leakage in EEG-Based Survival Prediction: A Two-Stage Embedding and Transformer Framework
summary:
Deep learning models have shown promise in EEG-based outcome prediction for comatose patients after cardiac arrest, but their reliability is often compromised by subtle forms of data leakage. In particular, when long EEG recordings are segmented into short windows and reused across multiple training stages, models may implicitly encode and propagate label information, leading to overly optimistic validation performance and poor generalization.
  In this study, we identify a previously overlooked form of data leakage in multi-stage EEG modeling pipelines. We demonstrate that violating strict patient-level separation can significantly inflate validation metrics while causing substantial degradation on independent test data.
  To address this issue, we propose a leakage-aware two-stage framework. In the first stage, short EEG segments are transformed into embedding representations using a convolutional neural network with an ArcFace objective. In the second stage, a Transformer-based model aggregates these embeddings to produce patient-level predictions, with strict isolation between training cohorts to eliminate leakage pathways.
  Experiments on a large-scale EEG dataset of post-cardiac-arrest patients show that the proposed framework achieves stable and generalizable performance under clinically relevant constraints, particularly in maintaining high sensitivity at stringent specificity thresholds. These results highlight the importance of rigorous data partitioning and provide a practical solution for reliable EEG-based outcome prediction.

AI.tldr: 研究解决了心脏骤停后昏迷患者EEG结局预测中的数据泄漏问题。提出了一个两阶段框架：第一阶段使用带ArcFace目标的CNN将EEG片段转换为嵌入表示；第二阶段使用Transformer模型聚合嵌入进行患者水平预测，并严格隔离训练队列避免泄漏。在大规模数据集上的实验表明该框架在临床相关约束下具有稳定且可泛化的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前深度学习模型在基于EEG预测昏迷患者结局方面存在可靠性问题。多阶段建模流程中，当长程EEG记录被分段并跨多训练阶段重用时，模型可能隐式编码和传播标签信息，导致验证性能过度乐观但泛化能力差。这是一个此前被忽视的数据泄漏形式。
AI.method: 1) 识别多阶段EEG建模流程中患者级别分离不严格的问题；2) 提出泄漏感知的两阶段框架：第一阶段使用带ArcFace目标的CNN将短EEG片段转换为嵌入表示；第二阶段使用Transformer模型聚合嵌入生成患者水平预测，严格隔离训练队列以消除泄漏途径。
AI.result: 所提框架在心脏骤停后患者的大规模EEG数据集上表现出稳定且可泛化的性能，特别是在严格特异性阈值下保持高敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了严格数据分区的重要性，并提供了一个可靠的EEG结局预测实用解决方案。两阶段设计结合嵌入学习和Transformer聚合，有效消除了传统pipeline中的数据泄漏问题。

title: ATime-Consistent Benchmark for Repository-Level Software Engineering Evaluation
summary: Evaluation of repository-aware software engineering systems is often confounded by synthetic task design, prompt leakage, and temporal contamination between repository knowledge and future code changes. We present a time-consistent benchmark methodology that snapshots a repository at time T0, constructs repository-derived code knowledge using only artifacts available before T0, and evaluates on engineering tasks derived from pull requests merged in the future interval (T0, T1]. Each historical pull request is transformed into a natural-language task through an LLM-assisted prompt-generation pipeline, and the benchmark is formalized as a matched A/B comparison in which the same software engineering agent is evaluated with and without repository-derived code knowledge while all other variables are held constant. We also report a baseline characterization study on two open-source repositories, DragonFly and React, using three Claude-family models and four prompt granularities. Across both repositories, file-level F1 increases monotonically from minimal to guided prompts, reaching 0.8081 on DragonFly and 0.8078 on React for the strongest tested model. These results show that prompt construction is a first-order benchmark variable. More broadly, the benchmark highlights that temporal consistency and prompt control are core validity requirements for repository-aware software engineering evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套"时间一致"的仓库级软件工程基准方法：在时刻 T0 对代码库做快照，仅用 T0 之前的信息构建"仓库衍生代码知识"，并以区间 (T0, T1] 内合并的历史 PR 通过 LLM 流水线转成自然语言任务，采用匹配 A/B 设计（同一 SWE agent 在有无仓库知识两种条件下对比）以隔离知识层的边际因果效应。作者在 DragonFly 与 React 两个仓库、三个 Claude 系模型、四种提示粒度上做了"仅基线"的标定研究：文件级 F1 随提示细化单调上升，最强模型在 Guided 提示下分别达 0.8081 与 0.8078，任务级分布显示零精度率从 60.2% 降至 3.5%，证明提示粒度是基准的一阶变量，并推荐 Contextual 为默认设置。
AI.motivation: 仓库感知的软件工程系统（如检索、代码图、语义索引、仓库记忆）依赖外部知识层，但现有评测往往把多种因素压缩成单一分数，可能因提示冗长、未来信息泄漏、隐藏实现提示而"奖励"错误的系统。要评估这类"仓库知识增强系统"，必须同时满足三个约束：(1) 任务来自真实工程工作而非合成练习；(2) 系统只能访问任务产生时刻可获得的信息；(3) 仓库知识的贡献必须与提示细节、模型配置、执行环境等混淆因素隔离。现有的 SWE-bench、RepoBench、SWE-PolyBench、FEA-Bench 等基准主要评估整体任务表现，SWE-MERA、SWE-rebench 关注基准新鲜度与抗污染，但均未在严格的前后快照分离（pre/post-snapshot separation）下估计外部仓库知识层的增量效应。作者的核心问题是：在固定快照、固定任务、固定模型、固定环境、固定指标的条件下，仓库衍生代码知识本身的边际效应有多大。
AI.method:
1) 时间一致协议：在 T0 快照仓库 R_T0，离线知识构建流水线仅可使用该快照中已有的源文件、提交历史与文档，明确排除 T0 之后的 PR 描述、diff、评审评论、新增文件与下游测试结果；任务集 D 来自 (T0, T1] 内合并的 PR 集合 P。
2) 匹配 A/B 设计：对每个任务 t_i，用同一个 SWE agent 在基线条件（仅快照）与知识增强条件（快照 + 由该快照构建的知识）各跑一次；控制变量包括 agent 与语言模型、仓库快照、任务提示、执行环境与评测指标，唯一自变量是是否可访问仓库知识。得分按 metric(A_S(t_i), y_i) 对任务集取平均。
3) LLM 辅助的提示生成函数 t_i = g(p_i, ℓ)，ℓ ∈ {Minimal, Concise, Contextual, Guided}：Minimal 仅由 PR 标题派生的高层描述；Concise 加入受影响组件/模块；Contextual 加入功能、场景或失效模式但不含函数名与控制流；Guided 提供较强的修复方向性指引但避免直接暴露真值实现。Contextual 被定为默认主设置。
4) 指标：文件级定位质量，预测相关文件集与 PR 修改文件集对比，计算 Precision/Recall/F1（TP/FP/FN 定义），并补充任务级极端分布分析（Precision=0、Recall=0、Recall=1 比例、F1 分布形状）。
5) 实验设置：DragonFly 与 React 两个仓库，三个模型（Claude-Sonnet-4、Claude-Sonnet-4.5、Claude-Ops-4.6），四种提示粒度；React 每个条件含 90 个历史 PR 任务；本节仅报告基线臂。
AI.result: DragonFly：Sonnet-4 的 F1 从 Minimal 0.2026 升至 Guided 0.6828；Sonnet-4.5 从 0.2487 升至 0.7163；Ops-4.6 从 0.2952 升至 0.8081（Recall 0.8071、Precision 0.8562）。React 复现同一趋势：Minimal 下 F1 仅 0.1898–0.2335，Guided 下分别达 0.6283、0.7229、0.8078（Ops-4.6 Recall 0.8503、Precision 0.8205）。三个观察：提示粒度强烈影响测得分（最大跳升出现在 Concise→Contextual，说明含仓库锚定的模块信息对文件定位尤为关键）；同粒度下更强模型在全部指标上一致更优；跨仓库趋势一致，说明该效应非单一仓库伪影。任务级分布分析（React，三模型平均）：零精度率 60.2%（Minimal）→28.7%（Concise）→18.5%（Contextual）→3.5%（Guided）；完美召回率 14.4%→31.1%→41.5%→59.8%；Ops-4.6 零精度率 56.1%→15.6%（Contextual）→1.1%（Guided），完美召回 16.7%→47.2%→66.1%。即提示强化带来的是分布"形状变化"（概率质量从零性能箱迁往高 F1 与精确匹配箱），而非仅均值上移。作者据此判定 Contextual 为最可辩护的主操作点：既能消除大量欠规范失败，又未像 Guided 那样使基准饱和。跨仓库 Guided 下最强分数几乎相同（0.8081 vs 0.8078），说明更丰富的任务框架可部分抵消仓库难度，代价是削弱对仓库探索的需求。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是方法论而非效果证明：时间一致性与提示控制对仓库感知的软件工程基准而言是核心有效性要求，真实性、新鲜度与执行式评测本身并不足够，当科学问题涉及仓库知识层的净效应时还必须做匹配因果控制。作者明确声明本研究仅为标定研究——当前只报告基线臂，尚未量化仓库知识的边际增益，因此未来任何 A/B 增益都必须明显大于或可与提示构造本身引起的方差区分开。威胁与局限包括：缺少配对的知识增强 vs 基线差值；不确定性报告不完整（缺置信区间、极端比例的双比例检验、分布检验的汇总表）；提示生成细节欠规范（缺精确模板、LLM 转换指令、显式泄漏过滤机制）；指标范围窄（仅文件级定位，非最终补丁正确性，缺 patch 成功率与测试通过率）；仓库覆盖仅两个，不足以支撑广泛泛化。下一步工作为完成配对 A/B 评测并给出任务级差值、不确定性估计、精确提示模板与更广的仓库覆盖。

title: Personalizing Mathematical Game-based Learning for Children: A Preliminary Study
comment: Short research paper accepted at 27th International Conference on AI in Education (AIED 2026)
summary: Game-based learning (GBL) is widely adopted in mathematics education. It enhances learners' engagement and critical thinking throughout the mathematics learning process. However, enabling players to learn intrinsically through mathematical games still presents challenges. In particular, effective GBL systems require dozens of high-quality game levels and mechanisms to deliver them to appropriate players in a way that matches their learning abilities. To address this challenge, we propose a framework, guided by adaptive learning theory, that uses artificial intelligence (AI) techniques to build a classifier for player-generated levels. We collect 206 distinct game levels created by both experts and advanced players in Creative Mode, a new tool in a math game-based learning app, and develop a classifier to extract game features and predict valid game levels. The preliminary results show that the Random Forest model is the optimal classifier among the four machine learning classification models (k-nearest neighbors, decision trees, support vector machines, and random forests). This study provides insights into the development of GBL systems, highlighting the potential of integrating AI into the game-level design process to provide more personalized game levels for players.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个基于自适应学习理论的AI框架，用于构建玩家生成游戏关卡的分类器。研究收集了206个由专家和高级玩家在数学游戏学习应用的创意模式中创建的关卡，通过提取游戏特征并预测有效关卡，最终确定随机森林为四种机器学习分类模型中的最优选择。
AI.motivation: 游戏化学习(GBL)在数学教育中广泛应用，能提升学习者参与度和批判性思维。然而，设计大量高质量游戏关卡并将其精准匹配给相应学习能力的玩家仍是重大挑战，现有GBL系统难以实现真正内在学习。
AI.method: 1) 在数学游戏学习应用的创意模式(Creative Mode)中收集206个由专家和高级玩家创建的关卡；2) 提取关卡的游戏特征；3) 构建分类器预测有效关卡；4) 比较四种机器学习分类模型：k近邻、决策树、支持向量机和随机森林。
AI.result: 随机森林(Random Forest)模型在四种机器学习分类模型中表现最优，成为预测玩家生成关卡有效性的最佳分类器。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为GBL系统开发提供了新思路，揭示了将AI技术融入游戏关卡设计过程的潜力，可为玩家提供更加个性化的游戏关卡，推动自适应游戏化学习的实现。

title: From Personas to Programming: Gender-specific Effects of Design Thinking-Based Computing Education at Secondary Schools
summary: Creative approaches to attract students to software engineering at an early age are emerging, yet their differential impact on gender remains unclear. This study investigates whether design thinking's empathy-driven approach addresses the documented gender gap in interest in software engineering. In a 10-week curriculum-integrated design thinking software development course with 55 secondary school students aged 13-15 from two schools in Canada, we examined gendered differences in perceived gains in knowledge and interest, as well as in social-emotional experiences. Our results show that both girls and boys gained perceived knowledge in software development. However, girls showed significant improvements in self-efficacy, interest, engagement with sustainability topics, and well-being, including optimism, sense of usefulness, and social connectedness. Positive emotions were strongest during creative, collaborative phases, while technical tasks led to some boredom, especially among boys, though they still benefited overall. This suggests that human-centred design thinking might be one effective way to address gender equity challenges, though we need more differentiated technical implementations.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨设计思维（同理心驱动的方法）是否能弥合软件工程教育中的性别差距。对加拿大两所学校的55名13-15岁中学生进行了10周课程整合的设计思维软件开发课程研究发现：男生和女生都获得了知识提升，但女生在自我效能感、兴趣、可持续性话题参与度及整体幸福感方面有显著提升；男生在技术任务阶段表现出更多无聊感；创意协作阶段对两性均产生最积极的情绪体验。
AI.motivation: 软件工程领域存在显著的性别差距，早期教育干预可能是解决该问题的关键。设计思维以人为本的核心特征（强调同理心、协作和创意）可能比传统技术教学更能吸引女生，但这一假设尚未得到实证验证。
AI.method: 研究采用准实验设计，在加拿大两所学校实施10周课程整合的设计思维软件开发课程（N=55，年龄13-15岁）。采用问卷调查和情绪体验日志收集数据，运用定量分析方法检验性别差异。
AI.result: 女生在自我效能感、兴趣、可持续性话题参与度和整体幸福感（包括乐观感、价值感和社会联结感）方面均有显著提升；男生和女生在知识获得方面无显著差异；技术任务阶段引发部分无聊感，尤其在男生群体中更为明显。
AI.conclusion: 以人为中心的设计思维可能是解决软件工程领域性别平等挑战的有效途径，但需要进一步优化技术实践环节的教学设计。研究建议未来应开发更具差异化的技术实施方案，以持续提升所有学生的参与度和学习体验。

title: Online Learning for Dynamic Constellation Topologies
summary: The use of satellite networks has increased significantly in recent years due to their advantages over purely terrestrial systems, such as higher availability and coverage. However, to effectively provide these services, satellite networks must cope with the continuous orbital movement and maneuvering of their nodes and the impact on the network's topology. In this work, we address the problem of (dynamic) network topology configuration under the online learning framework. As a byproduct, our approach does not assume structure about the network, such as known orbital planes (that could be violated by maneuvering satellites). We empirically demonstrate that our problem formulation matches the performance of state-of-the-art offline methods. Importantly, we demonstrate that our approach is amenable to constrained online learning, exhibiting a trade-off between computational complexity per iteration and convergence to a final strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文将卫星星座动态拓扑配置问题形式化为带约束的在线凸优化（OCO）问题：以拉普拉斯矩阵表示拓扑，通过加权最小二乘目标（逼近连通性矩阵、鼓励星地连接）与拉普拉斯性质约束构建凸优化；并用超平面/锥面近似卫星视场（FOV）来刻画物理不可连接约束。该方法不依赖轨道面等先验结构，离线性能与 +Grid 等最优方法相当，且可自然接入 OGD 与 OCG 在线算法，在单次迭代计算耗时与收敛速度之间提供可调权衡。
AI.motivation: 卫星网络（尤其是 LEO 星座）持续轨道运动、卫星机动、发射与退役以及碰撞/碎片风险导致网络拓扑不断变化，必须动态重配置以维持服务稳定与质量。但纯动态策略（每发包都重新探测邻居与链路状态）会带来显著性能开销，因此需要在"拓扑自适应"与"计算/通信开销"之间取得权衡。现有静态方法（VT、VN、+Grid、×Grid）依赖已知的轨道面结构，且机动会破坏该假设；动态方法则开销大、易受链路故障与拥塞影响。作者希望把动态拓扑配置问题置于在线学习（在线凸优化）框架下：既获得接近离线最优解的性能，又具备在线适应能力，并且不假设网络结构。
AI.method: 1) 问题建模：把网络拓扑建模为拉普拉斯矩阵 X，定义带约束的凸优化问题——目标为 min_X ||(X-P)⊙U||_F^2 - Tr(Λ⊙X)，即加权最小二乘逼近由连通性矩阵 P（0/-1 元素）描述的"理想拓扑"，其中 U 为逐元素效用矩阵（本文取卫星间距离的倒数，并对基站项放大 10^2 以鼓励星地连接）；Λ 为对角矩阵，含 λ_bs、λ_sat 权重，利用 Tr(L)=2m 的性质鼓励网络连通。约束包括：对称性 X=X^T、行和为零、对角元上界 max_ISL/max_BSL、非对角元在 [-1,0]。2) 连通性约束（FOV 近似）：(a) 单超平面近似——超平面与地球表面相切、法向量为卫星相对地心的归一化向量，落在另一侧的卫星对不可连接；(b) 锥面近似——以卫星为顶点、与地球相切的圆锥面，通过点积比较判定归属；两者取交集得到更精确 FOV，超平面数量越多越精确但越慢。3) 在线学习：采用 OCO 框架，对抗者事后给出凸代价函数 f_t，比较对象为动态最优决策 u_t=argmin f_t，指标为动态遗憾。算法为投影类 OGD（在梯度下降后投影到决策集）与免投影类 OCG（Frank-Wolfe 在线版，通过线性优化求解）。以离线解作为初始输入与"黄金标准"，用式(8) 归一化 Frobenius 残差衡量在线解与离线解的偏差。4) 实现：CVXPY 求解。实验包括 Iridium 类星座（6 椭圆轨道面 × 11 卫星，无基站）与 +Grid 对比；以及 18 卫星单轨道面 + 2 固定基站、1000 次迭代的动态仿真。
AI.result: 1) 有效性验证：+Grid 边数 130、平均度 3.94、密度 0.06、连通分量 1、平均最短路径 4.04、平均聚类系数 0.02；本文方法在超平面 FOV 下为 121 / 3.67 / 0.06 / 1 / 4.68 / 0.15，超平面+锥面 FOV 下为 113 / 3.42 / 0.06 / 1 / 4.88 / 0.12。即在不使用轨道面信息（比较对 +Grid 有利）的条件下，本文方法生成的拓扑在边数、平均度、密度、连通性、最短路径与聚类系数上与最优方法相当，仅平均最短路径略差。2) OCO 对比：初期 OCG 残差高于 OGD，但随时间下降；OGD 最终残差最小。墙钟时间为 OCG 2.712±0.06 ms、OGD 3.954±0.07 ms，即 OCG 学习网络动态需要更多迭代，但单次迭代平均快 31%，验证了"计算复杂度 vs 收敛速度"的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将动态卫星星座拓扑配置表述为带约束的在线凸优化问题，其离线变体的图统计指标可与假设轨道面结构的 +Grid 竞争，证明"不依赖网络结构假设"这一副产品可行；所提在线方法也可用于在线适应卫星运动与机动带来的拓扑变化，并可通过投影式（OGD）与免投影式（OCG）算法在每轮计算开销与收敛到最终策略之间灵活取舍。作者指出未来方向：引入更有意义的星间链路特性（如丢包率、缓冲队列）、探索更多 OCO 变体与不同的拓扑条件化/初始化方式，以及考虑强化学习以处理非凸代价（但存在灾难性遗忘风险）。所有结果均基于仿真，作者在伦理声明中强调该技术的双用途属性与负责任部署。

title: An Object Web Seminar: A Retrospective on a Technical Dialogue Still Reverbarating
comment: Record of early Web Object technology and evolution since then covered in 6 pages with 4 figures
summary: Technology change happens quickly such that new trends tend to crowd out the focus on what was new just yesterday. In this paper the peak popularity of the confluence of Object Technologies with early Web adoption is explored through the content of a seminar held in 1999. Distributed architectures were undergoing significant change at this point, and deeper software capabilities were just beginning to be broadly accessible over the Internet. The Object Web arose and was infused with new development tools reflecting these capabilities and allowing design of applications for deployment during the early days of the World Wide Web. This conference discussed the history, evolution, and use of these tools, architectures, and their future possibilities. The continued dominance of these approaches although under different names is demonstrated even though the term Object Web has receded in use. Favored newer offerings such as Kubernetes and microservices still model the core design attributes of the Object Web for example. Aside from connecting this seminar to relevance in the software world of today this paper also touches on the early AI tools demonstrated in this seminar a quarter century ago and how the popularity wave of any given technology might affect the current focus on AI technology offerings.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了1999年一次关于"Object Web"的研讨会，探讨了对象技术与早期Web架构的融合，指出尽管"Object Web"这一术语已不再流行，但其核心设计原则仍延续体现在Kubernetes、微服务等现代技术中，并讨论了当时展示的早期AI工具对当今AI技术热潮的启示意义。
AI.motivation: 技术变革迅速，新趋势往往很快掩盖昨日的创新。文章旨在重新审视1999年Object Web研讨会的历史价值，证明早期分布式架构和对象技术的核心设计属性在当今Kubernetes、微服务等现代技术中仍占主导地位，同时反思技术流行浪潮对当前AI技术关注的影响。
AI.method: 通过对1999年研讨会的历史内容进行分析，将早期Object Web的工具、架构与当今技术栈（如Kubernetes、微服务）进行对比，论证核心设计原则的延续性；同时考察了当时展示的早期AI工具的发展轨迹。
AI.result: 证明了Object Web的核心设计属性在当今技术中仍然占主导地位，尽管术语已不再使用。例如Kubernetes和微服务等较新的技术仍在沿用Object Web的核心设计理念。此外，早期AI工具的发展路径提示了当前AI技术热潮可能存在的类似波动性。
AI.conclusion: Object Web虽已退出流行语行列，但其设计理念长盛不衰。技术流行具有周期性特征，当前对AI技术的狂热关注可能需要理性审视，历史上类似的技术浪潮提示了技术更迭的规律。

title: EngineAD: A Real-World Vehicle Engine Anomaly Detection Dataset
summary: The progress of Anomaly Detection (AD) in safety-critical domains, such as transportation, is severely constrained by the lack of large-scale, real-world benchmarks. To address this, we introduce EngineAD, a novel, multivariate dataset comprising high-resolution sensor telemetry collected from a fleet of 25 commercial vehicles over a six-month period. Unlike synthetic datasets, EngineAD features authentic operational data labeled with expert annotations, distinguishing normal states from subtle indicators of incipient engine faults. We preprocess the data into $300$-timestep segments of $8$ principal components and establish an initial benchmark using nine diverse one-class anomaly detection models. Our experiments reveal significant performance variability across the vehicle fleet, underscoring the challenge of cross-vehicle generalization. Furthermore, our findings corroborate recent literature, showing that simple classical methods (e.g., K-Means and One-Class SVM) are often highly competitive with, or superior to, deep learning approaches in this segment-based evaluation. By publicly releasing EngineAD, we aim to provide a realistic, challenging resource for developing robust and field-deployable anomaly detection and anomaly prediction solutions for the automotive industry.

AI.tldr: EngineAD是一个新颖的多变量数据集，包含来自25辆商用车六个月期间的高分辨率传感器遥测数据，旨在解决安全关键领域异常检测缺乏真实世界基准的问题。数据集包含专家标注的正常状态和细微发动机故障指标，已预处理为300时间步、8个主成分的片段，并使用9种单类异常检测模型进行基准测试。研究发现简单经典方法（如K-Means、One-Class SVM）在该任务上与深度学习方法具有竞争力甚至更优。
AI.motivation: 安全关键领域（如交通）的异常检测（AD）研究受到缺乏大规模真实世界基准数据集的严重制约，现有合成数据集无法满足实际应用需求。
AI.method: 收集25辆商用车6个月的高分辨率传感器遥测数据；专家标注区分正常状态与细微发动机故障迹象；数据预处理为300时间步、8个主成分的片段；使用9种单类异常检测模型建立基准测试。
AI.result: 跨车型泛化性能存在显著差异；简单经典方法（K-Means、One-Class SVM）在基于片段的评估中表现与深度学习方法相当甚至更优。
AI.conclusion: EngineAD为汽车行业异常检测与预测解决方案的开发提供了现实且具有挑战性的基准资源。

title: Automating Domain-Driven Design: Experience with a Prompting Framework
comment: \c{opyright} 20XX IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes, creating new collective works, for resale or redistribution to servers or lists, or reuse of any copyrighted component of this work in other works
summary: Domain-driven design (DDD) is a powerful design technique for architecting complex software systems. This paper introduces a prompting framework that automates core DDD activities through structured large language model (LLM) interactions. We decompose DDD into five sequential steps: (1) establishing an ubiquitous language, (2) simulating event storming, (3) identifying bounded contexts, (4) designing aggregates, and (5) mapping to technical architecture. In a case study, we validated the prompting framework against real-world requirements from FTAPI's enterprise platform. While the first steps consistently generate valuable and usable artifacts, later steps show how minor errors or inaccuracies can propagate and accumulate. Overall, the framework excels as a collaborative sparring partner for building actionable documentation, such as glossaries and context maps, but not for full automation. This allows the experts to concentrate their discussion on the critical trade-offs. In our evaluation, Steps 1 to 3 worked well, but the accumulated errors rendered the artifacts generated from Steps 4 and 5 impractical. Our findings show that LLMs can enhance, but not replace, architectural expertise, offering a practical tool to reduce the effort and overhead of DDD while preserving human-centric decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于结构化LLM交互的提示框架，用于自动化领域驱动设计(DDD)的核心活动，包含5个顺序步骤。通过FTAPI企业平台的案例研究验证了该框架的有效性，结果表明LLM可作为协作伙伴帮助生成可操作文档（如术语表和上下文图），但无法完全自动化DDD过程。
AI.motivation: 领域驱动设计(DDD)是架构复杂软件系统的强大设计技术，但执行DDD需要大量专业知识和精力。现有的LLM技术已展示出在软件工程任务中的潜力，但缺乏专门针对DDD工作流的系统性自动化方法。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个包含5个顺序步骤的提示框架：(1)建立通用语言 (2)模拟事件风暴 (3)识别限界上下文 (4)设计聚合 (5)映射到技术架构。通过FTAPI企业平台的真实需求进行案例研究验证。
AI.result: 前几步（1-3步）持续生成有价值的可用工件，但后续步骤中微小错误会传播和累积。步骤1-3效果良好，但累积错误导致步骤4-5生成的工件不切实际。
AI.conclusion: LLM可增强但无法替代架构专业知识。该框架作为协作伙伴表现优异，能生成术语表和上下文图等可操作文档，有效减少DDD的工作量和开销，同时保留以人为本的决策方式。

title: Adversarial-Robust Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection via Joint Information Retention
summary: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) is a critical component in monitoring complex systems, yet modern deep learning-based detectors are often highly sensitive to localized input corruptions and structured noise. We propose ARTA (Adversarially Robust multivariate Time-series Anomaly detection via joint information retention), a joint training framework that improves detector robustness through a principled min-max optimization objective. ARTA comprises an anomaly detector and a sparsity-constrained mask generator that are trained simultaneously. The generator identifies minimal, task-relevant temporal perturbations that maximally increase the detector's anomaly score, while the detector is optimized to remain stable under these structured perturbations. The resulting masks characterize the detector's sensitivity to adversarial temporal corruptions and can serve as explanatory signals for the detector's decisions. This adversarial training strategy exposes brittle decision pathways and encourages the detector to rely on distributed and stable temporal patterns rather than spurious localized artifacts. We conduct extensive experiments on the TSB-AD benchmark, demonstrating that ARTA consistently improves anomaly detection performance across diverse datasets and exhibits significantly more graceful degradation under increasing noise levels compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ARTA框架，通过对抗性训练提升时序异常检测模型对输入扰动和结构化噪声的鲁棒性。核心思想是让检测器依赖分布式的稳定时序模式，而非局部的虚假特征。
AI.motivation: 现代深度学习时序异常检测器对局部输入损坏和结构化噪声高度敏感，容易依赖虚假的局部特征做出决策，导致鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 提出ARTA联合训练框架，包含异常检测器和稀疏约束掩码生成器，通过min-max优化目标进行对抗训练。生成器识别最小化、任务相关的时序扰动以最大化检测器的异常分数，检测器则被优化以在这些结构化扰动下保持稳定。
AI.result: 在TSB-AD基准测试上的广泛实验表明，ARTA在多个数据集上一致提升异常检测性能，且在噪声水平增加时表现出显著更优的降级鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 对抗训练策略能有效暴露脆弱决策路径，强制检测器依赖分布式的稳定时序模式而非局部伪影，所生成的掩码还可作为检测器决策的解释信号。

title: Developers and Generative AI: A Study of Self-Admitted Usage in Open Source Projects
comment: Accepted for publication in "Empirical Software Engineering" journal
summary: The availability of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools such as ChatGPT or GitHub Copilot is reshaping the way in which software is developed, evolved, and maintained. Oftentimes, developers leave traces of such an usage in software artifacts. This allows not only to understand how AI is used in software development, but also to let others be aware how such software artifacts were created, e.g., for licensing or trustworthiness purposes. This paper-building upon our preliminary work presented at MSR 2024-aims at qualitatively investigating on the self-admitted use of two very popular generative AI tools - ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot - in software development. To this aim, we mined GitHub for such traces, by looking at commits, issues and pull requests (PRs). Then, through a manual coding, we create a taxonomy of 64 different ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot usage tasks, grouped into 7 categories. By repeating our previous analysis two years after and by extending it to GitHub Copilot, we show how the usage avenues have been expanded, the extent to which developers perceived such a generative AI usage useful, and whether some concerns occurring more than one year ago are no longer present. The taxonomy of tasks we derived from such a qualitative study provided (i) developers with valuable insights into how generative AI can be integrated into their workflows, and (ii) researchers with a clear overview of tasks that developers perceive as well-suited for automation.

AI.tldr: 本研究对GitHub上ChatGPT和GitHub Copilot的自述使用情况进行了定性调查研究，通过手动编码创建了包含64种任务的分类法（分为7类），并对比了两年间的变化，发现生成式AI的使用领域已显著扩展。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI工具（如ChatGPT和GitHub Copilot）正在重塑软件开发方式，开发者常在软件制品中留下使用痕迹。理解这些痕迹有助于了解AI在软件开发中的实际应用情况，并为许可和可信度目的提供参考。
AI.method: 从GitHub挖掘提交（commits）、问题（issues）和拉取请求（PRs）中的AI使用痕迹，通过手动编码进行定性分析，创建任务分类法。
AI.result: 识别出64种ChatGPT和GitHub Copilot的使用任务，归为7个类别；发现使用方式已显著扩展；分析了开发者对生成式AI的感知有用性；验证了部分早期担忧是否仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: 该任务分类法为开发者提供了将生成式AI集成到工作流程中的有价值见解，为研究人员提供了开发者认为适合自动化的任务概览。

title: On the Objective and Feature Weights of Minkowski Weighted k-Means
summary: The Minkowski weighted k-means (mwk-means) algorithm extends classical k-means by incorporating feature weights and a Minkowski distance. Despite its empirical success, its theoretical properties remain insufficiently understood. We show that the mwk-means objective can be expressed as a power-mean aggregation of within-cluster dispersions, with the order determined by the Minkowski exponent p. This formulation reveals how p controls the transition between selective and uniform use of features. Using this representation, we derive bounds for the objective function and characterise the structure of the feature weights, showing that they depend only on relative dispersion and follow a power-law relationship with dispersion ratios. This leads to explicit guarantees on the suppression of high-dispersion features. Finally, we establish convergence of the algorithm and provide a unified theoretical interpretation of its behaviour.

AI.tldr: 本文对 Minkowski 加权 k-means（mwk-means）给出了系统的理论刻画：其目标函数可等价写成簇内离散度（within-cluster dispersion）的幂平均聚合，阶数 r = -1/(p-1) 由 Minkowski 指数 p 决定；由此推出目标函数的上下界、特征权重的幂律结构与高离散度特征的抑制保证，以及算法的有限步收敛性。进一步，作者基于该理论提出 CAFE（Cluster-Adaptive Feature Extraction），用 mwk-means 学到的簇内特征权重对数据做簇自适应重缩放后再做无监督特征提取，理论上证明重缩放会反转簇内离散度次序，从而在含簇内噪声时系统性优于直接特征提取。
AI.motivation: 经典 k-means 假设所有特征同等重要，而现实数据中特征相关性差异显著。特征加权聚类方法（如 mwk-means）虽在实践中成功且被用于估计簇数，但其理论基础薄弱：Minkowski 指数 p 在目标函数中的角色、权重产生的结构与尺度规律、算法收敛性等问题均缺乏严格刻画；同时实践中也缺少一种能有效处理"簇内噪声"（仅在部分簇中被污染的特征）的无监督特征提取手段。
AI.method: （1）理论分析：证明 p>1 时 f_p(z)=Σ|x_iv−z|^p 严格凸且强制性（coercive），故 Minkowski 中心唯一（Proposition 1）；由交替最优化与有限聚类数推出目标单调下降、有限步收敛到局部极小（Theorem 1）。（2）关键重写：将最优权重 w_lv 代回目标，得 Lemma 1 的纯离散度表达式 W_p = Σ_l 1/(Σ_v D_lv^{-1/(p-1)})^{p-1}；再由幂平均定义得 Lemma 2：W_p = (1/m^{p-1}) Σ_l M_r(D_l·)，r = −1/(p−1) < 0；由幂平均序关系给出 Theorem 2 的上下界（p→1^+ 取最小离散度，p→∞ 取几何平均）。（3）权重结构：Proposition 2 给出 w_lv = D_lv^{-1/(p-1)}/Σ_t D_lt^{-1/(p-1)} 及比值 w_lv/w_lu = (D_lu/D_lv)^{1/(p−1)}，说明权重只依赖相对离散度且对整体缩放不变；Corollary 2（p→1^+ 时权重集中于最小离散度特征，趋于硬特征选择）、Corollary 3（权重比随 p 单调趋于 1，趋于均匀 1/m）、Theorem 3（成对幂律抑制 w_lu ≤ C^{-1/(p-1)} w_lv）、Theorem 4（全局抑制 w_lu ≤ 1/[1+(m−1)C^{1/(p−1)}]）。（4）实证插图：高斯混合+噪声特征上 p∈{1.1,1.5,2,5} 的权重分布与归一化目标值均落在理论区间 [0,1] 内（均值 0.10–0.82）。（5）新方法 CAFE：对每个 p∈{1.1,1.5,2,3} 运行 50 次 mwk-means 取目标最低解，用 ARI 一致性选 p*，再按 x̃_iv = w_lv·x_iv 重缩放；Lemma 3 证明 D̃_lu/D̃_lv = (D_lu/D_lv)^{-1/(p−1)}，即离散度次序反转，Corollary 4 给出显式抑制界 D̃_lu ≤ D_lu/[1+(m−1)C^{1/(p−1)}]^p。（6）实验：9 个 UCI 数据集（one-hot 编码），3 个噪声幅度 σ∈{1,2,5} × 2 个噪声水平 η∈{20%,40%}，共 1080 个含噪版本，统一 r=⌊m/2⌋ 维，k-means 100 次取最优后计算 ARI；对比 PCA/NMF/ICA/自编码器/UMAP 五个基线。
AI.result: CAFE 在 54 组配置中 48 组优于对应基线（η=20% 时 22/27，η=40% 时 27/27），且优势随噪声水平 η 与幅度 σ 增大而增强；η=40% 时全部配置均改善（如 AustraCC σ=5：PCA 0.126→CAFE+PCA 0.235，ICA 0.112→CAFE+ICA 0.465；Ionosphere σ=5：PCA 0.116→0.680）。少数失败案例出现在低噪声幅度下（AustraCC、CarEvaluation 的 σ∈{1,2}、Ionosphere σ=1、Iris σ=5），与理论一致——噪声幅度小时不足以在簇内离散度上区分噪声与信息特征。Autoencoder 与 UMAP 基线整体弱于 PCA/NMF/ICA；三个 CAFE 变体互不支配，CAFE+PCA 与 CAFE+ICA 绝对提升最大。理论部分的经验验证显示：p 越小权重越稀疏、p 越大越接近均匀，归一化目标值全部落在理论界内。
AI.conclusion: mwk-means 的目标本质上是对簇内离散度做幂平均聚合（阶数 r=−1/(p−1)），因而 Minkowski 指数 p 是"特征选择性 vs 均匀性"的平滑调节参数：p→1^+ 退化为硬特征选择，p→∞ 权重趋于均匀；权重比严格遵循以 1/(p−1) 为指数的幂律，故高离散度（噪声）特征被指数级抑制，这一机制解释了算法对异质特征相关性的经验鲁棒性，并给出了收敛性保证。基于该理论提出的 CAFE 通过簇自适应重缩放反转簇内离散度次序，使噪声特征被压低、信息特征被放大，从而在受控簇内噪声下稳定提升 PCA/NMF/ICA 等特征提取后的聚类质量（ARI）。未来工作：扩展到其他聚类形式、考察对 p 的敏感性、研究"高离散度=噪声"假设仅部分成立时的行为。

title: Do Neurons Dream of Primitive Operators? Wake-Sleep Compression Rediscovers Schank's Event Semantics
summary:
We show that they do. Schank's conceptual dependency theory proposed that all events decompose into primitive operations -- ATRANS, PTRANS, MTRANS, and others -- hand-coded from linguistic intuition. Can the same primitives be discovered automatically through compression pressure alone?
  We adapt DreamCoder's wake-sleep library learning to event state transformations. Given events as before/after world state pairs, our system finds operator compositions explaining each event (wake), then extracts recurring patterns as new operators optimized under Minimum Description Length (sleep). Starting from four generic primitives, it discovers operators mapping directly to Schank's: MOVE_PROP_has = ATRANS, CHANGE_location = PTRANS, SET_knows = MTRANS, SET_consumed = INGEST, plus compound operators ("mail" = ATRANS + PTRANS) and novel emotional state operators absent from Schank's taxonomy.
  We validate on synthetic events and real-world commonsense data from the ATOMIC knowledge graph. On synthetic data, discovered operators achieve Bayesian MDL within 4% of Schank's hand-coded primitives while explaining 100% of events vs. Schank's 81%. On ATOMIC, results are more dramatic: Schank's primitives explain only 10% of naturalistic events, while the discovered library explains 100%. Dominant operators are not physical-action primitives but mental and emotional state changes -- CHANGE_wants (20%), CHANGE_feels (18%), CHANGE_is (18%) -- none in Schank's original taxonomy.
  These results provide the first empirical evidence that event primitives can be derived from compression pressure, that Schank's core primitives are information-theoretically justified, and that the complete inventory is substantially richer than proposed -- with mental/emotional operators dominating in naturalistic data.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索事件基元是否可以通过压缩压力自动发现，而非依赖人工编码。研究采用DreamCoder的唤醒-睡眠库学习方法，从事件的前后世界状态对中自动发现操作符。结果表明，从四个初始基元出发，系统能自动发现与Schank概念依赖理论相匹配的操作符，且在自然主义数据上发现的操作符远超Schank原始分类，其中心理和情绪状态变化操作符占主导地位。
AI.motivation: Schank的概念依赖理论假设所有事件可分解为人工编码的原始操作（ATRANS、PTRANS、MTRANS等），但这些基元是否具有信息论上的必然性？研究旨在通过纯压缩压力自动发现相同基元，验证Schank理论的合理性并扩展其边界。
AI.method: 研究将DreamCoder的唤醒-睡眠库学习方法适配到事件状态转换任务。系统以事件的前后世界状态对为输入，通过唤醒阶段学习解释事件的算子组合，睡眠阶段利用最小描述长度原则（MDL）提取重复模式为新操作符。初始从四个通用基元出发，逐步构建算子库。
AI.result: 合成数据上，发现的操作符在贝叶斯MDL上与Schank手动编码基元相差4%以内，且能解释100%的事件（Schank基元仅81%）。在ATOMIC知识图的自然主义数据上，差距更大：Schank基元仅解释10%的事件，而发现的库解释100%。主导操作符并非物理动作基元，而是心理和情绪状态变化——CHANGE_wants（20%）、CHANGE_feels（18%）、CHANGE_is（18%），这些均不在Schank原始分类中。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了事件基元可从压缩压力推导的首次实证证据，证实Schank核心基元具有信息论合理性，并表明完整基元清单远比原提议丰富——在自然主义数据中，心理/情绪操作符占主导地位。这为理解人类事件表征的压缩本质提供了新视角。

title: A Benchmark for Evaluating Repository-Level Code Agents with Intermediate Reasoning on Feature Addition Task
summary: Repository-level code agents have shown strong promise in real-world feature addition tasks, making reliable evaluation of their capabilities increasingly important. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate these agents as black boxes based on final test correctness, providing limited insight into how they reason and where failures arise. To address this limitation, we introduce RACE-bench, a reasoning-augmented benchmark for evaluating code agents on repository-level feature addition tasks. RACE-bench contains 528 real-world feature addition instances from 12 open-source repositories. Each instance is paired with executable patch verification and structured intermediate reasoning ground truth covering issue understanding, file localization, implementation tasks, and step decomposition. Based on this design, we introduce a dual-track evaluation framework that jointly measures patch correctness and intermediate reasoning quality. We evaluate three representative repository-level code agents on RACE-bench. On the full benchmark, Resolved Rates range from 29% to 70% across different agents. Our reasoning-level analysis further shows that while current agents perform well at understanding high-level intent, their performance degrades substantially when translating intent into concrete implementation steps. We also find that apply-success but test-fail cases exhibit lower reasoning recall (35.7% decrease) and higher over-prediction (94.1% increase) compared to successful cases. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating repository-level code agents beyond final patch correctness by examining the quality of their reasoning processes.

AI.tldr: RACE-bench是一个用于评估仓库级代码智能体的推理增强基准测试，包含528个真实世界的功能添加任务实例，配套可执行补丁验证和结构化中间推理真值。通过双轨评估框架，揭示了当前代码智能体在将高层意图转化为具体实现步骤时性能显著下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试主要将代码智能体作为黑盒评估，仅关注最终测试正确性，缺乏对智能体推理过程和失败原因的深入理解。这限制了研究者识别关键能力缺陷和指导未来改进方向。
AI.method: 构建RACE-bench基准：1）收集12个开源仓库的528个真实功能添加实例；2）每个实例配备可执行补丁验证和覆盖问题理解、文件定位、实现任务、步骤分解的结构化中间推理真值；3）设计双轨评估框架同时衡量补丁正确性和推理质量。
AI.result: 评估三种代表性仓库级代码智能体，任务解决率为29%-70%。推理层级分析显示：智能体在高层意图理解表现良好，但在将意图转化为具体实现步骤时性能显著下降；apply成功但test失败的案例相比完全成功案例，推理召回率下降35.7%，过度预测增加94.1%。
AI.conclusion: 评估仓库级代码智能体需要超越最终补丁正确性，关注推理过程质量。RACE-bench提供的中间推理真值和双轨评估框架为识别智能体能力短板（如意图-实现转换）提供了有效工具。

title: H-Node Attack and Defense in Large Language Models
summary: We present H-Node Adversarial Noise Cancellation (H-Node ANC), a mechanistic framework that identifies, exploits, and defends hallucination representations in transformer-based large language models (LLMs) at the level of individual hidden-state dimensions. A logistic regression probe trained on last-token hidden states localizes hallucination signal to a small set of high-variance dimensions -- termed Hallucination Nodes (H-Nodes) -- with probe AUC reaching 0.90 across four architectures. A white-box adversarial attack amplifies these dimensions at inference time via a real-time forward hook, achieving a selectivity of 3.02x with less than 10% visibility to the defender. Adaptive ANC defense suppresses H-Node excess in-pass using confidence-weighted cancellation, reducing grounded activation drift by 33-42% over static cancellation. A dynamic iterative extension that re-ranks cancellation targets across successive passes recovers up to 0.69 robustness from a single-pass baseline of 8%. All contributions are validated on OPT-125M, Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct, LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct, and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 (125M-8B parameters). Perplexity impact is surgical (<5%) and MMLU degradation is at most 3%, confirming that the defense does not impair general reasoning capability.

AI.tldr: H-Node ANC框架通过定位LLM中导致幻觉的特定隐藏状态维度(H-Nodes)，实现幻觉的检测、放大和防御。实验证明该方法在多个模型上AUC达0.90，防御可将激活漂移减少33-42%，同时保持模型推理能力基本不变。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型(LLM)普遍存在幻觉问题，严重影响其可靠性和实用性。现有方法多从行为层面抑制幻觉，缺乏对模型内部幻觉生成机制的深入理解与精准干预。该研究旨在从隐藏状态维度层面识别、操纵和防御幻觉表征。
AI.method: 1) 使用逻辑回归探针分析最后token的隐藏状态，定位高方差幻觉信号维度(H-Nodes)；2) 通过白盒对抗攻击和前向钩子实时放大H-Nodes以验证脆弱性；3) 采用置信度加权消除的自适应ANC防御机制；4) 动态迭代扩展在连续解码过程中重新排序消除目标。
AI.result: 探针AUC达0.90（跨4种架构）；对抗攻击选择性3.02倍，防御可见性<10%；自适应防御减少33-42% grounded激活漂移；动态迭代恢复0.69鲁棒性；在OPT-125M、Phi-3-mini、LLaMA-3-8B、Mistral-7B上验证。
AI.conclusion: 该防御机制对困惑度影响<5%，MMLU下降≤3%，证明在不损害模型通用推理能力的前提下可有效抑制幻觉。

title: Second-Order, First-Class: A Composable Stack for Curvature-Aware Training
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures. Code available at https://github.com/cor3bit/somax
summary: Second-order methods promise improved stability and faster convergence, yet they remain underused due to implementation overhead, tuning brittleness, and the lack of composable APIs. We introduce Somax, a composable Optax-native stack that treats curvature-aware training as a single JIT-compiled step governed by a static plan. Somax exposes first-class modules -- curvature operators, estimators, linear solvers, preconditioners, and damping policies -- behind a single step interface and composes with Optax by applying standard gradient transformations (e.g., momentum, weight decay, schedules) to the computed direction. This design makes typically hidden choices explicit and swappable. Somax separates planning from execution: it derives a static plan (including cadences) from module requirements, then runs the step through a specialized execution path that reuses intermediate results across modules. We report system-oriented ablations showing that (i) composition choices materially affect scaling behavior and time-to-accuracy, and (ii) planning reduces per-step overhead relative to unplanned composition with redundant recomputation.

AI.tldr: Somax是一个基于Optax的二阶优化器框架，通过模块化设计（曲率算子、估计器、线性求解器、预条件器、阻尼策略）和静态规划机制，解决了二阶方法实现复杂、调试困难、组合性差的问题，实现了JIT编译优化和计算中间结果复用。
AI.motivation: 二阶优化方法虽能提供更好的稳定性和收敛速度，但因实现开销大、调试脆弱、缺乏可组合API而未被广泛使用。现有系统隐藏了关键实现细节，且各组件间存在冗余计算。
AI.method: Somax将曲率感知训练封装为单一JIT编译步骤，通过静态计划驱动。核心设计包括：(1) 模块化接口：暴露曲率算子、估计器、线性求解器、预条件器、阻尼策略等一等模块；(2) 规划-执行分离：从模块需求推导静态计划（含节奏），通过专用执行路径复用模块间中间结果；(3) 与Optax标准梯度变换（动量、权重衰减、学习率调度）无缝组合。
AI.result: 实验表明：(1) 组合选择显著影响扩展性和时间-精度权衡；(2) 静态规划相比无规划组合减少每步开销，避免冗余计算。
AI.conclusion: Somax使隐含的实现选择显式化并可替换，为二阶优化方法提供了实用、灵活、高效的解决方案。

title: Can AI Models Direct Each Other? Organizational Structure as a Probe into Training Limitations
summary: Can an expensive AI model effectively direct a cheap one to solve software engineering tasks? We study this question by introducing ManagerWorker, a two-agent pipeline where an expensive "manager" model (text-only, no code execution) analyzes issues, dispatches exploration tasks, and reviews implementations, while a cheap "worker" model (with full repo access) executes code changes. We evaluate on 200 instances from SWE-bench Lite across five configurations that vary the manager-worker relationship, pipeline complexity, and model pairing. Our findings reveal both the promise and the limits of multi-agent direction: (1) a strong manager directing a weak worker (62%) matches a strong single agent (60%) at a fraction of the strong-model token usage, showing that expensive reasoning can substitute for expensive execution; (2) a weak manager directing a weak worker (42%) performs worse than the weak agent alone (44%), demonstrating that the directing relationship requires a genuine capability gap--structure without substance is pure overhead; (3) the manager's value lies in directing, not merely reviewing--a minimal review-only loop adds just 2pp over the baseline, while structured exploration and planning add 11pp, showing that active direction is what makes the capability gap productive; and (4) these behaviors trace to a single root cause: current models are trained as monolithic agents, and splitting them into director/worker roles fights their training distribution. The pipeline succeeds by designing around this mismatch--keeping each model close to its trained mode (text generation for the manager, tool use for the worker) and externalizing organizational structure to code. This diagnosis points to concrete training gaps: delegation, scoped execution, and mode switching are skills absent from current training data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ManagerWorker双智能体框架，让昂贵的"管理器"模型指导廉价的"工作器"模型完成软件工程任务。在SWE-bench Lite的200个实例上验证了多智能体方向的有效性和局限性，发现强管理器+弱工作器组合（62%）能达到强单智能体（60%）的水平但大幅降低token消耗；弱管理器+弱工作器组合（42%）反而不如弱智能体单独工作（44%），说明方向关系需要真正的能力差距；管理器的价值在于主动指导而非仅审核；当前模型作为整体智能体训练，分离为director/worker角色与其训练分布不匹配。
AI.motivation: 探索昂贵AI模型能否有效指导廉价模型解决软件工程任务，以降低高级AI系统的使用成本，同时保持性能。
AI.method: 提出ManagerWorker双智能体管道：管理器（仅文本、无代码执行能力）分析问题、分派任务、审查实现；工作器（有完整代码仓库访问权限）执行代码变更。在SWE-bench Lite的200个实例上评估5种配置，变化管理器-工作器关系、管道复杂度和模型配对。
AI.result: 四个关键发现：(1)强管理器+弱工作器（62%）≈强单智能体（60%），昂贵推理可替代昂贵执行；(2)弱管理器+弱工作器（42%）<弱智能体单独（44%），无实质的能力差距反而增加开销；(3)管理器价值在主动指导而非仅审核——最小审核循环仅增加2pp，而结构化探索和规划增加11pp；(4)根因是当前模型按整体智能体训练，分离为director/worker角色与其训练分布不匹配。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体方向需设计弥补训练差距：保持各模型接近训练模式（管理器文本生成、工作器工具使用），将组织结构外部化到代码。指出具体训练缺口：委托、作用域执行和模式切换能力在当前训练数据中缺失。

title: Selective Deficits in LLM Mental Self-Modeling in a Behavior-Based Test of Theory of Mind
summary: The ability to represent oneself and others as agents with knowledge, intentions, and belief states that guide their behavior - Theory of Mind - is a human universal that enables us to navigate - and manipulate - the social world. It is supported by our ability to form mental models of ourselves and others. Its ubiquity in human affairs entails that LLMs have seen innumerable examples of it in their training data and therefore may have learned to mimic it, but whether they have actually learned causal models that they can deploy in arbitrary settings is unclear. We therefore develop a novel experimental paradigm that requires that subjects form representations of the mental states of themselves and others and act on them strategically rather than merely describe them. We test a wide range of leading open and closed source LLMs released since 2024, as well as human subjects, on this paradigm. We find that 1) LLMs released before mid-2025 fail at all of our tasks, 2) more recent LLMs achieve human-level performance on modeling the cognitive states of others, and 3) even frontier LLMs fail at our self-modeling task - unless afforded a scratchpad in the form of a reasoning trace. We further demonstrate cognitive load effects on other-modeling tasks, offering suggestive evidence that LLMs are using something akin to limited-capacity working memory to hold these mental representations in mind during a single forward pass. Finally, we explore the mechanisms by which reasoning models succeed at the self- and other-modeling tasks, and show that they readily engage in strategic deception.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种新型实验范式，测试LLM是否真正习得了因果性的心智理论（ToM），而不仅仅是模仿训练数据中的模式。研究发现2025年中期前的LLM全部失败，但更近期模型在其他心智建模任务上达到人类水平，然而在自我建模任务上仍表现不佳（除非使用推理痕迹）。实验还发现认知负荷效应和战略欺骗行为。
AI.motivation: 心智理论是人类社会的普遍能力，使我们能够代表自己和他人行事。尽管LLM在训练数据中见过无数心智理论的例子，但它们是否真正学会了可跨场景部署的因果模型仍不清楚——这关乎LLM是否真正理解社会认知，还是仅在模仿模式。
AI.method: 开发了一种要求被试形成自我和他人心理状态表征并战略性行动的新型实验范式，而非仅仅描述心理状态。测试了自2024年以来发布的多种开源和闭源LLM，以及人类被试。包括自我建模任务、他人建模任务，并探索认知负荷效应和推理模型的成功机制。
AI.result: 1) 2025年中期前发布的LLM全部失败；2) 更近期的LLM在他人心理状态建模任务上达到人类水平；3) 即使前沿LLM在自我建模任务上仍失败——除非提供推理痕迹(scratchpad)；4) 发现认知负荷效应，表明LLM可能使用类似有限容量工作记忆的方式保持心理表征；5) 推理模型能够进行战略性欺骗。
AI.conclusion: LLM的心智理论能力正在快速发展，但仍存在关键局限：自我建模能力落后于他人建模；推理痕迹对自我建模至关重要；推理模型具备战略欺骗能力。这些发现表明LLM可能正在发展类似人类工作记忆的认知机制，但其完整性和可靠性仍需进一步研究。

title: QuitoBench: A High-Quality Open Time Series Forecasting Benchmark
summary: Time series forecasting is critical across finance, healthcare, and cloud computing, yet progress is constrained by a fundamental bottleneck: the scarcity of large-scale, high-quality benchmarks. To address this gap, we introduce \textsc{QuitoBench}, a regime-balanced benchmark for time series forecasting with coverage across eight trend$\times$seasonality$\times$forecastability (TSF) regimes, designed to capture forecasting-relevant properties rather than application-defined domain labels. The benchmark is built upon \textsc{Quito}, a billion-scale time series corpus of application traffic from Alipay spanning nine business domains. Benchmarking 10 models from deep learning, foundation models, and statistical baselines across 232,200 evaluation instances, we report four key findings: (i) a context-length crossover where deep learning models lead at short context ($L=96$) but foundation models dominate at long context ($L \ge 576$); (ii) forecastability is the dominant difficulty driver, producing a $3.64 \times$ MAE gap across regimes; (iii) deep learning models match or surpass foundation models at $59 \times$ fewer parameters; and (iv) scaling the amount of training data provides substantially greater benefit than scaling model size for both model families. These findings are validated by strong cross-benchmark and cross-metric consistency. Our open-source release enables reproducible, regime-aware evaluation for time series forecasting research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QuitoBench，一个基于Alipay应用流量数据的十亿级时间序列预测基准测试，覆盖8种趋势×季节性×可预测性（TSF） regimes，在232,200个评估实例上测试10个模型，揭示了上下文长度交叉、预测难度主导因素、模型效率及数据规模vs模型规模的重要发现。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测领域缺乏大规模、高质量的基准测试，现有benchmark多基于应用领域标签而非预测相关属性划分，导致研究进展受限。
AI.method: 构建Quito（Alipay九大业务领域的十亿级时间序列语料库），基于趋势×季节性×可预测性三个维度划分8种regimes，设计QuitoBench对10个模型（深度学习、基础模型、统计基线）进行232,200个实例的评估。
AI.result: 四项关键发现：①短上下文(L=96)深度学习领先，长上下文(L≥576)基础模型占优；②可预测性是主要难度驱动因素，regimes间MAE差距达3.64倍；③深度学习模型以59倍更少参数匹配或超越基础模型；④扩展训练数据量比扩展模型规模收益更大。
AI.conclusion: QuitoBench提供了跨基准和跨指标一致性验证的regime-aware评估框架，开源发布支持可复现研究，揭示了数据 scaling 优于模型 scaling这一重要规律。

title: Beyond Banning AI: A First Look at GenAI Governance in Open Source Software Communities
summary: Generative AI (GenAI) is playing an increasingly important role in open source software (OSS). Beyond completing code and documentation, GenAI is increasingly involved in issues, pull requests, code reviews, and security reports. Yet, cheaper generation does not mean cheaper review - and the resulting maintenance burden has pushed OSS projects to experiment with GenAI-specific rules in contribution guidelines, security policies, and repository instructions, even including a total ban on AI-assisted contributions. However, governing GenAI in OSS is far more than a ban-or-not question. The responses remain scattered, with neither a shared governance framework in practice nor a systematic understanding in research. Therefore, in this paper, we conduct a multi-stage analysis on various qualitative materials related to GenAI governance retrieved from 67 highly visible OSS projects. Our analysis identifies recurring concerns across contribution workflows, derives three governance orientations, and maps out 12 governance strategies and their implementation patterns. We show that governing GenAI in OSS extends well beyond banning - it requires coordinated responses across accountability, verification, review capacity, code provenance, and platform infrastructure. Overall, our work distills dispersed community practices into a structured overview, providing a conceptual baseline for researchers and a practical reference for maintainers and platform designers.

AI.tldr: 本研究对67个高可见度开源软件项目中的生成式AI（GenAI）治理相关定性材料进行多阶段分析，识别出贡献工作流中的反复出现的问题，归纳出三种治理取向，并绘制出12种治理策略及其实现模式。研究表明，GenAI治理远非简单的禁止问题，而是需要在问责、验证、审查能力、代码溯源和平台基础设施等方面协调应对。
AI.motivation: 随着GenAI在开源软件（OSS）中的应用日益广泛（代码补全、文档、问题处理、安全报告等），项目维护负担加重。OSS社区开始尝试制定GenAI相关规则，但治理措施分散，缺乏共享的治理框架和系统性理解。
AI.method: 对67个高可见度OSS项目中的GenAI治理定性材料进行多阶段分析（multi-stage analysis）。
AI.result: 识别出贡献工作流中的反复出现的问题；推导出三种治理取向；绘制出12种治理策略及其实现模式。
AI.conclusion: GenAI治理需超越简单的禁止措施，需要在问责机制、验证流程、审查能力、代码溯源和平台基础设施等方面协调应对。本研究将分散的社区实践提炼为结构化概述，为研究者提供概念基准，为维护者和平台设计者提供实践参考。

title: Dynamic Tokenization via Reinforcement Patching: End-to-end Training and Zero-shot Transfer
summary: Efficiently aggregating spatial or temporal horizons to acquire compact representations has become a unifying principle in modern deep learning models, yet learning data-adaptive representations for long-horizon sequence data, especially continuous sequences like time series, remains an open challenge. While fixed-size patching has improved scalability and performance, discovering variable-sized, data-driven patches end-to-end often forces models to rely on soft discretization, specific backbones, or heuristic rules. In this work, we propose Reinforcement Patching (ReinPatch), the first framework to jointly optimize a sequence patching policy and its downstream sequence backbone model using reinforcement learning. By formulating patch boundary placement as a discrete decision process optimized via Group Relative Policy Gradient (GRPG), ReinPatch bypasses the need for continuous relaxations and performs dynamic patching policy optimization in a natural manner. Moreover, our method allows strict enforcement of a desired compression rate, freeing the downstream backbone to scale efficiently, and naturally supports multi-level hierarchical modeling. We evaluate ReinPatch on time-series forecasting datasets, where it demonstrates compelling performance compared to state-of-the-art data-driven patching strategies. Furthermore, our detached design allows the patching module to be extracted as a standalone foundation patcher, providing the community with visual and empirical insights into the segmentation behaviors preferred by a purely performance-driven neural patching strategy.

AI.tldr: ReinPatch 用强化学习把「变长 patch 边界放置」当作离散决策问题求解，与下游时序骨干网络端到端联合优化（GRPG，contextual bandit 形式），无需软化离散或启发式规则；通过严格压缩率约束与解耦设计，可提取出独立的“基础 patcher”并实现零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 序列数据的动态 tokenization（patching）是决定长上下文建模效率的关键。BPE 之类的离散分词不适用于连续时间序列；PatchTST 的固定长度 patch 虽有效但无法刻画强时序异质性。现有可变长方案各有缺陷：BLT/EntroPE 用外部熵模型、TimeSqueeze 用局部方差、SpaceByte 用分隔符等外部规则，无法与主干联合优化；H-Net/SRSNet 用连续松弛（smoothed routing）做端到端学习，但边界决策被耦合到主干隐状态流形上：无法“先训 patcher 再冻结继续预训练主干”、探索空间局限于当前边界邻域、且受因果架构约束。作者因此希望用 RL 这一天然适配离散动作的方法，把边界放置与下游预测性能直接挂钩，并让 patcher 完全独立于骨干设计。
AI.method:
**建模**：定义辅助边界序列 b_{0:T}（b_t∈{0,1} 表示 x_t 右端是否切边界，b_{-1}=1），边界集合决定 patch 划分；骨干 q_φ(x_T,b_T) 在该划分下做下采样/上采样后输出预测。
**动作空间与奖励**：状态 s≜x_T，动作 a≜b_T，π(a|s)=π_θ(b_{0:T}|x_T)，奖励 R(s,a)=−L(q_φ(x_T,b_T), y)。对非因果任务（预测/MLM/分类）可整段一次性决策，等价为 contextual bandit；生成式任务给出多步 MDP 统一形式（Appendix B），训练时用“one-step MDP + 共享终局奖励”实现并行决策与奖励计算。
**优化算法**：Group Relative Policy Gradient (GRPG)：每条序列采样 G 组边界，用组内奖励的均值/标准差做优势估计 A=(R−μ_R)/(σ_R+ε)，纯 on-policy 单步更新；不用 GRPO/PPO 是因为环境（骨干）采样便宜且持续演化，多 epoch 复用易破坏策略，且从零训练无参考策略锚（可按需加熵项替代 KL 锚）。
**严格压缩率**：在环境端设置最小压缩率 r_m，若策略给出的压缩率低于 r_m，则把右侧多余 patch 合并为一个（故意让环境更难，因为近端信息更重要），从而避免“specification gaming”，并让骨干可按最坏情况之外的最优压缩比直接放大模型规模；这是“环境内硬约束”而非 H-Net 的软辅助损失。
**架构**：策略网络是独立轻量 Transformer（嵌入 m_θ + 线性头 f_θ: d_patch→2），与骨干完全解耦；骨干为统一的下采样编码器+潜空间 Transformer+上采样解码器+预测头。多级层次化只需把 f_θ 输出维度改为 L，b_t=l 表示 x_t 右端同时是前 l 层的边界（保证下层边界是上层子集），可一次性规划多层。
**推理时适配**：上下文任务用 top-k 选取边界，k=⌊T/r_c⌋（未指定时用期望边界数 k̂=Σ(1+e^{−l_t})^{−1}）；因果/生成式任务因需在线满足全局预算，采用滑动窗口分位数阈值法，但无法严格满足目标压缩率，属遗留问题。
AI.result:
**主实验**（8 数据集 × 4 预测长度 H∈{96,192,336,720} × 5 seed，多变量长时预测，look-back ∈ {96,192,336}）：零样本 ReinPatch 平均 MSE/MAE 平均排名均为 1.125，8 个数据集中 7 个 MSE 上至少与端到端持平、MAE 全部持平；在 ETTh2、ETTm1、Traffic 上取得最佳平均 MSE。相对最强熵基线，平均 MSE 降 4.9%、MAE 降 3.3%，Traffic 增益最大（MSE −13.5%、MAE −15.4%）。32 个（数据集×horizon）设置中零样本变体在 19 个 MSE、15 个 MAE 上第一，加端到端变体共占 64 项中的 42 项第一；Friedman–Nemenyi 检验显示对所有六个非 ReinPatch 基线在两项指标上均统计显著（MSE p≈4e-15，MAE p≈8e-8；CD=1.86）。
**消融**（固定同一 Transformer 骨干与边界参数化，只换边界学习方式）：零样本 ReinPatch 单独在 24/32(MSE)、20/32(MAE) 最佳，含端到端变体则达 30/32 与 25/32；STE 直通估计、Gumbel-Softmax、同骨干 H-Net chunking、UTSD 预训练冻结的 Entropy-UTSD 仅在零星格子上胜出，说明增益源于 RL 目标本身而非架构或预训练曝光。
**其他分析**：look-back 增至 720 时 ReinPatch 明显甩开熵基线（熵代理与预测效用随长上下文失配）；对 patcher 学习率、最小压缩率、骨干深度/隐维不敏感；固定压缩率 r_c=8 下的边界位置置换检验中 28 个数据集配对有 27 对显著（仅 ETTh2–ETTm2 p=0.265 不显著），证明边界位置随数据结构变化而非退化随机；UTSD 上实际平均压缩率 10.92（>r_m=8），说明约束被内化。
**效率**（ETTh1, L=336→H=720, bs=32）：ReinPatch 138.6 MB/sample、847.0 samples/s；静态 111.9 MB、949.8 samples/s；熵 patcher 323.4 MB、883.6 samples/s；patcher 仅约 49K 参数（主干 2.25M），MACs 5.06G（静态 4.79G，熵 7.27G），说明精度提升不来自额外容量/算力。
**可视化**：学到的边界集中于主要转折点附近，同时“包裹”局部小偏移以保留季节性与有信息量的过渡形状，且单个 patch 通常不跨越多个转折点。
AI.conclusion: ReinPatch 首次用强化学习把数据自适应序列切分与下游序列模型的端到端联合优化结合起来，摆脱软离散与人工规则，实现严格压缩率、可解耦的“基础 patcher”与零样本迁移；在多变量时序预测上相对 SOTA patching 策略取得统计显著且稳定的增益，并给出可解释的分割模式。作者承认的局限：基础 patcher 仅在单变量动态上预训练，多变量跨通道切分依赖仍是开放问题；因果多步 MDP 下让 patcher 进一步上下文化决策、以及生成式任务推理时严格压缩率控制尚未解决。未来方向：将该范式作为 LLM 中 BPE 的免分词动态替代、扩展到音频与基因组、用 PPO 适配超大骨干、以及用自监督目标（如 masked patch 重建）把 patcher 变成自监督分割前端。

title: GLU: Global-Local-Uncertainty Fusion for Scalable Spatiotemporal Reconstruction and Forecasting
summary: Digital twins of complex physical systems are expected to infer unobserved states from sparse measurements and predict their evolution in time, yet these two functions are typically treated as separate tasks. Here we present GLU, a Global-Local-Uncertainty framework that formulates sparse reconstruction and dynamic forecasting as a unified state-representation problem and introduces a structured latent assembly to both tasks. The central idea is to build a structured latent state that combines a global summary of system-level organization, local tokens anchored to available measurements, and an uncertainty-driven importance field that weights observations according to the physical informativeness. For reconstruction, GLU uses importance-aware adaptive neighborhood selection to retrieve locally relevant information while preserving global consistency and allowing flexible query resolution on arbitrary geometries. Across a suite of challenging benchmarks, GLU consistently improves reconstruction fidelity over reduced-order, convolutional, neural operator, and attention-based baselines, better preserving multi-scale structures. For forecasting, a hierarchical Leader-Follower Dynamics module evolves the latent state with substantially reduced memory growth, maintains stable rollout behavior and delays error accumulation in nonlinear dynamics. On a realistic turbulent combustion dataset, it further preserves not only sharp fronts and broadband structures in multiple physical fields, but also their cross-channel thermo-chemical couplings. Scalability tests show that these gains are achieved with substantially lower memory growth than comparable attention-based baselines. Together, these results establish GLU as a flexible and computationally practical paradigm for sparse digital twins.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GLU（Global-Local-Uncertainty）框架，将稀疏重建与动态预测统一为状态表示问题。核心创新在于构建包含全局系统级摘要、局部测量锚定令牌、以及不确定性驱动的自适应重要性权重的结构化潜空间。方法在重建任务中采用重要性感知邻域选择，预测任务中采用层级Leader-Follower动力学模块实现低内存演化和稳定rollout。
AI.motivation: 当前数字孪生系统中，稀疏测量重建（状态推断）与时序预测（动态演化）通常被作为独立任务处理，缺乏统一框架。此外，现有方法在处理不规则几何、保持多尺度结构、平衡局部精度与全局一致性方面存在局限。
AI.method:
1. 结构化潜态设计：融合全局系统级总结、局部测量锚定令牌、及不确定性驱动的物理信息重要性场；
2. 重建模块：重要性感知自适应邻域选择，实现局部相关性与全局一致性的平衡，支持任意几何的灵活查询；
3. 预测模块：层级Leader-Follower动力学模块，压缩状态演化复杂度，降低内存增长。
AI.result:
1. 重建任务：多基准测试中一致优于ROM、CNN、神经算子及注意力基线，更好保持多尺度结构；
2. 预测任务：降低内存增长、保持稳定rollout、延缓非线性动力学误差积累；
3. 燃烧场景：保留锐利锋面、宽频结构及跨通道热化学耦合；
4. 可扩展性：相比注意力基线显著降低内存增长。
AI.conclusion: GLU为稀疏数字孪生提供了一种灵活、计算实用的范式，成功统一了状态重建与动态预测任务，并在精度、稳定性、可扩展性上展现了全面优势。

title: Beyond Code Snippets: Benchmarking LLMs on Repository-Level Question Answering
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive capabilities across software engineering tasks, including question answering (QA). However, most studies and benchmarks focus on isolated functions or single-file snippets, overlooking the challenges of real-world program comprehension, which often spans multiple files and system-level dependencies. In this work, we introduce StackRepoQA, the first multi-project, repository-level question answering dataset constructed from 1,318 real developer questions and accepted answers across 134 open-source Java projects. Using this dataset, we systematically evaluate two widely used LLMs (Claude 3.5 Sonnet and GPT-4o) under both direct prompting and agentic configurations. We compare baseline performance with retrieval-augmented generation methods that leverage file-level retrieval and graph-based representations of structural dependencies. Our results show that LLMs achieve moderate accuracy at baseline, with performance improving when structural signals are incorporated. Nonetheless, overall accuracy remains limited for repository-scale comprehension. The analysis reveals that high scores often result from verbatim reproduction of Stack Overflow answers rather than genuine reasoning. To our knowledge, this is the first empirical study to provide such evidence in repository-level QA. We release StackRepoQA to encourage further research into benchmarks, evaluation protocols, and augmentation strategies that disentangle memorization from reasoning, advancing LLMs as reliable tool for repository-scale program comprehension.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 StackRepoQA——首个公开、跨多项目、具备训练截止日期感知能力的仓库级问答基准，由 1,318 个真实 Stack Overflow 提问及其被采纳答案映射到 134 个活跃 Java 仓库构成，并在其上系统评测 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 与 GPT-4o 在直接提示、多智能体框架下的文件级 RAG 与图结构 RAG 表现。核心结论：模型无增强时准确率仅中等（约 58%/平均分 6.67–6.94），很大一部分成绩来自对 Stack Overflow 已见内容的记忆复述；加入结构化图检索增益最大（6.12 vs 文件级 5.66），但整体仍难以支撑真实仓库级理解。作者开源数据集与评测管线，呼吁采用截止日期切分等协议以剥离记忆与推理。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 程序理解研究多聚焦单函数/单文件片段，无法反映真实项目中跨文件、跨组件的程序理解需求（开发者约 58% 工作时间用于理解代码库）。同时，仓库级 QA 的现有数据集（如 CoReQA、CodeRepoQA）多由 LLM 从 GitHub issue 重构 Q&A，缺乏真实开发者提问；且已有 benchmark 未区分「记忆」与「推理」，可能高估模型能力。RAG 虽被广泛使用，但纯文本相似度检索难以捕获函数调用、类继承、数据流等结构依赖，且无关上下文会造成「干扰效应」进一步降低准确率。
AI.method: 数据集构建：通过 GitHub API（2025-06-09 采集）筛选 Java 仓库（≥20 贡献者、≥10 stars、≥1000 commits、≥10MB、宽松许可证、近 12 个月有提交），手工剔除无源码/教程类项目及名称易混淆项目，得 420 个活跃仓库；从 Stack Exchange 官方数据转储（截至 2025-04-03）以仓库名做关键词匹配得 233,175 个候选问题，每仓随机抽 7–10 个有被采纳答案的问题（功效分析要求每项目≥7 条），最终得到映射到 134 个仓库的 1,318 个 Q&A 对；由 15 年以上经验的 Java 开发者人工复核标记 249 个假阳性并保留为对照组，另两名评分者复核 20% 子集达到完全一致。实验：受资源限制，按功效分析抽取 482 题/49 仓库做配对比较。评测对象为 Claude 3.5 Sonnet（2024-06）与 GPT-4o（2024-05），默认推理设置；比较三种配置：仅 LLM（baseline）、LLM+File-RAG、LLM+File-RAG+Graph-RAG。基于 AutoGen 0.9.6 构建多智能体架构：File-RAG（ChromaDB + all-mpnet-base-v2 向量稠密检索，k=5）、Graph-RAG（基于 AST 与静态依赖构建 Neo4j 图，实体含类/方法/字段，关系含 CALLS/CONTAINS/EXTENDS/USES，由模型生成 Cypher 取子图）、Summarization Agent 与 Supervisor Agent（各检索智能体最多调用 3 轮）；消融实验单独禁用 File/Graph 智能体。提示按「Role-Context-Task-Rules-Output」画布框架设计。评分采用 LLM-as-a-judge（1–10 分，正确性/完整性/忠实性/简洁性），每条响应由两个模型独立评分以缓解自偏好；两名工程师评 30 条做一致性验证：人-人 κ=0.78，人-模型 κ=0.77/0.87，ICC(2,1)=0.82、ICC(2,k)=0.93。统计：Shapiro-Wilk 检验非正态后用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验，效应量用 Cliff's δ，另做线性混合效应模型（问题与项目随机截距）、截止日期前后切分分析与 Spearman 相关分析。
AI.result: RQ1（无增强）：GPT-4o 平均分 6.94 略优于 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 的 6.67；自评/交叉评评显示 Claude 自评 5.88、评 GPT 6.77，GPT 自评 7.08、评 Claude 7.21，存在自偏好与交叉偏好差异。与仓库「无关」问题得分 7.27 甚至高于「相关」问题 6.73（差异不显著），暗示高分来自训练期接触而非代码推理。截止日期分析：Claude 由 6.59 降至 5.44（p=0.0009），GPT-4o 由 6.97 降至 5.97（p=0.0024），呈显著下降。仓库规模/活跃度/热度与得分相关性均很小（规模 -0.24~-0.07，stars/forks 绝对值<0.22）。RQ2（增强）：禁用内置知识时，文件级 RAG 5.66、仅图 RAG 6.12（p<0.0002 优于文件级）、全智能体 6.11；允许同时使用内置知识与检索时相关问题升至 6.07–6.95，远高于无关问题 5.43（p<0.016）。截止日期前后均获益（前 6.59→7.00，后 5.44→5.68）。对无关问题施加检索反而降低性能，验证干扰效应。消融显示图智能体贡献主要增益，Claude 3.5 在利用图结构上下文上优于 GPT-4o。发现多例近乎逐字复现 Stack Overflow 被采纳答案（Debezium QID:6887、JUnit4 8633、Ebean 10582、OpenRouteService 9255、WireMock 37860 含「Stateful Behaviour」等独特措辞）。问题类型上，API 使用与概念澄清类得分高，配置/集成/查询类得分低。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 在仓库级 QA 上仅达中等准确率（约 58%–64% 区间，最佳配置约 64%），且成绩在很大程度上源于对 Stack Overflow 内容的记忆而非对源码的真实推理；截止日期后问题性能骤降即为证据。结构感知的图检索（继承、包含、跨文件调用等）是较文件级 RAG 更有效的增强手段，但整体仍不足以支撑实用部署，尤其在私有/快速演进项目中。后续方向包括：更大更丰富的结构信号（数据流、控制流、依赖解析、执行轨迹）、非文本表示（类图、调用图、IDE 视图）、扩展至其他语言与协作工件（GitHub Issues/Discussions）、上下文门控与自适应过滤策略、以及把「截止日期切分 + 未见仓库评测 + 记忆/推理分离指标」作为 SE 领域 LLM 评估的标准协议。

title: DPD-Cancer: Explainable Graph-based Deep Learning for Small Molecule Anti-Cancer Activity Prediction
summary: Accurate drug response prediction is a critical bottleneck in computational biochemistry, limited by the challenge of modelling the interplay between molecular structure and cellular context. In cancer research, this is acute due to tumour heterogeneity and genomic variability, which hinder the identification of effective therapies. Conventional approaches often fail to capture non-linear relationships between chemical features and biological outcomes across diverse cell lines. To address this, we introduce DPD-Cancer, a deep learning method based on a Graph Attention Transformer (GAT) framework. It is designed for small molecule anti-cancer activity classification and the quantitative prediction of cell-line specific responses, specifically growth inhibition concentration (pGI50). Benchmarked against state-of-the-art methods (pdCSM-cancer, ACLPred, and MLASM), DPD-Cancer demonstrated superior performance, achieving an Area Under ROC Curve (AUC) of up to 0.87 on strictly partitioned NCI60 data and up to 0.98 on ACLPred/MLASM datasets. For pGI50 prediction across 10 cancer types and 73 cell lines, the model achieved Pearson's correlation coefficients of up to 0.72 on independent test sets. These findings confirm that attention-based mechanisms offer significant advantages in extracting meaningful molecular representations, establishing DPD-Cancer as a competitive tool for prioritising drug candidates. Furthermore, DPD-Cancer provides explainability by leveraging the attention mechanism to identify and visualise specific molecular substructures, offering actionable insights for lead optimisation. DPD-Cancer is freely available as a web server at: https://biosig.lab.uq.edu.au/dpd_cancer/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于图注意力Transformer（GAT）的深度学习方法DPD-Cancer，用于小分子抗癌活性分类与细胞系特异性pGI50定量预测。该方法在严格划分的NCI60数据上AUC最高达0.87，在ACLPred/MLASM数据集上最高达0.98，覆盖10种癌症类型、73个细胞系的pGI50预测在独立测试集上Pearson相关系数最高0.72，并可通过注意力权重可视化关键分子亚结构以辅助先导化合物优化，已部署为免费网页服务器。
AI.motivation: 准确预测药物响应是计算生化的关键瓶颈，核心难点在于刻画分子结构与细胞上下文之间复杂的相互作用。癌症研究中尤为突出：肿瘤异质性与基因组变异导致有效疗法难以识别。传统方法（如基于描述符的机器学习）难以捕获化学特征与生物学结果之间跨细胞系的非线性关系，且往往忽略细胞背景信息。因此需要一个能够同时整合分子图结构信息与细胞系上下文、并具备可解释性的深度学习模型。
AI.method: 提出DPD-Cancer框架，以图注意力Transformer（GAT）为核心，将小分子表示为图结构（原子/键为节点与边），通过注意力机制学习加权聚合邻域信息以提取分子表示，实现两项任务：二分类的抗癌症活性判定，以及细胞系特异性的生长抑制浓度pGI50的定量回归。模型在NCI60（严格按划分的数据分割）以及ACLPred、MLASM数据集上进行基准测试，与pdCSM-cancer、ACLPred、MLASM等当前最优方法对比，以AUC和Pearson相关系数为评价指标。此外利用注意力权重定位并可视化重要分子亚结构，提供针对特定细胞系的机制性可解释性；并作为Web服务器公开发布（https://biosig.lab.uq.edu.au/dpd_cancer/）。
AI.result: 在严格划分的NCI60数据上，DPD-Cancer的AUC最高达0.87；在ACLPred/MLASM数据集上AUC最高达0.98，优于所对比的pdCSM-cancer、ACLPred和MLASM等方法。pGI50预测方面，涵盖10种癌症类型、73个细胞系，在独立测试集上Pearson相关系数最高达0.72，表明模型能刻画不同细胞系间的响应差异。注意力机制可视化结果显示模型能够聚焦于与活性相关的特定分子亚结构，为先导优化提供结构层面的提示。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明注意力机制在提取有意义分子表示方面具有显著优势，使DPD-Cancer成为候选药物优先级排序的竞争性工具，并可作为结构-活性关系研究的高效基线。模型的可解释性（基于注意力的子结构归因）使其在先导化合物优化中具有实际应用价值。局限性方面：细胞系上下文信息与细胞背景的整合方式仍有进一步拓展空间，且模型性能在罕见癌种与低质量数据上可能受限；实际临床转化尚需更多前瞻性验证。作者将工具以网页服务器形式开放以促进社区使用。

title: Identification of Bivariate Causal Directionality Based on Anticipated Asymmetric Geometries
summary: Identification of causal directionality in bivariate numerical data is a fundamental research problem with important practical implications. This paper presents two alternative methods to identify direction of causation by considering conditional distributions: (1) Anticipated Asymmetric Geometries (AAG) and (2) Monotonicity Index. The AAG method compares the actual conditional distributions to anticipated ones along two variables. Different comparison metrics, such as correlation, cosine similarity, Jaccard index, K-L divergence, K-S distance, and mutual information have been evaluated. Anticipated distributions have been projected as normal based on dual response statistics: mean and standard deviation. The Monotonicity Index approach compares the calculated monotonicity indexes of the gradients of conditional distributions along two axes and exhibits counts of gradient sign changes. Both methods assume stochastic properties of the bivariate data and exploit anticipated unimodality of conditional distributions of the effect. It turns out that the tuned AAG method outperforms the Monotonicity Index and reaches a top accuracy of 77.9% compared to ANMs accuracy of 63 +/- 10% when classifying 95 pairs of real-world examples (Mooij et al, 2014). The described methods include a number of hyperparameters that impact accuracy of the identification. For a given set of hyperparameters, both the AAG or Monotonicity Index method provide a unique deterministic outcome of the solution. To address sensitivity to hyperparameters, tuning of hyperparameters has been done by utilizing a full factorial Design of Experiment. A decision tree has been fitted to distinguish misclassified cases using the input data's symmetrical bivariate statistics to address the question of: How decisive is the identification method of causal directionality?

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种基于条件分布的因果方向识别方法：AAG（预期非对称几何）法和单调性指数法。在95对真实数据集上的实验表明，调优后的AAG方法达到77.9%的准确率，优于ANM方法的63±10%。
AI.motivation: 在双变量数值数据中识别因果方向是一个基础研究问题，具有重要实际应用价值。现有方法如加性噪声模型(ANM)准确率有限（63±10%），需要更有效的方法来提高因果方向识别的准确性。
AI.method: 提出两种替代方法：(1) AAG方法：比较实际条件分布与沿两个变量的预期分布，使用相关性、余弦相似度、Jaccard指数、K-L散度、K-S距离和互信息等指标；(2) 单调性指数法：比较沿两个轴的条件分布梯度的单调性指数。两种方法均假设因果效应的条件分布具有单峰性。采用全因子实验设计(Design of Experiment)进行超参数调优，并使用决策树分析误分类案例。
AI.result: 调优后的AAG方法达到77.9%的准确率，显著优于ANM方法的63±10%，且表现优于单调性指数法。决策树分析可用于区分误分类案例。
AI.conclusion: AAG方法通过比较条件分布与预期非对称几何形状，能够有效识别因果方向，在真实数据上展现出比传统ANM方法更高的准确率。超参数对识别准确性有显著影响，需谨慎调优。决策树方法有助于理解因果方向识别的决定性因素。

title: Sustainability Is Not Linear: Quantifying Performance, Energy, and Privacy Trade-offs in On-Device Intelligence
comment: Under review at Empirical Software Engineering (EMSE)
summary: The migration of Large Language Models (LLMs) from cloud clusters to edge devices promises enhanced privacy and offline accessibility, but this transition encounters a harsh reality: the physical constraints of mobile batteries, thermal limits, and, most importantly, memory constraints. To navigate this landscape, we constructed a reproducible experimental pipeline to profile the complex interplay between energy consumption, latency, and quality. Unlike theoretical studies, we captured granular power metrics across eight models ranging from 0.5B to 9B parameters without requiring root access, ensuring our findings reflect realistic user conditions. We harness this pipeline to conduct an empirical case study on a flagship Android device, the Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra, establishing foundational hypotheses regarding the trade-offs between generation quality, performance, and resource consumption. Our investigation uncovered a counter-intuitive quantization-energy paradox. While modern importance-aware quantization successfully reduces memory footprints to fit larger models into RAM, we found it yields negligible energy savings compared to standard mixed-precision methods. This proves that for battery life, the architecture of the model, not its quantization scheme, is the decisive factor. We further identified that Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures defy the standard size-energy trend, offering the storage capacity of a 7B model while maintaining the lower energy profile of a 1B to 2B model. Finally, an analysis of these multi-objective trade-offs reveals a pragmatic sweet spot of mid-sized models, such as Qwen2.5-3B, that effectively balance response quality with sustainable energy consumption.

AI.tldr: 本文在未 Root 的三星 Galaxy S25 Ultra 上构建了一套可复现的端侧 LLM 能量/性能/质量联合剖析流水线，评测了 8 个 0.5B–9B 模型（稠密与 MoE）与两种 4-bit 量化（Q4_K_M、IQ4_XS）。核心发现是“量化—能量悖论”：IQ4_XS 虽显著降低峰值内存，但能量与延迟无优势甚至更差，Q4_K_M 在生成速度、延迟、总能耗上全面胜出；说明电池续航的决定因素是模型架构与参数量级，而非量化方案。此外，MoE（OLMoE-1B-7B）凭借稀疏路由实现“7B 存储 + 1~2B 能耗”的错位优势，而 Qwen2.5-3B 构成质量与能耗的务实“甜点区”。
AI.motivation: LLM 从云端向端侧迁移带来隐私与离线可用性优势，但受限于手机电池容量、散热余量与统一内存带宽/容量；且自回归解码高度 memory-bound，内存搬运成为主要瓶颈。现有研究多孤立评估延迟或压缩技术，缺乏对“能量—内存可行性—性能—生成质量”联合关系的刻画。同时消费级手机的高精度能耗测量困难：外部硬件功率计（如 Monsoon）需拆机绕过电池，破坏真实热学行为；纯软件频率估计器在持续负载下受热节流、漏电流影响而失真。为此需要一套非侵入、可复现的端侧多目标测量方法。
AI.method: 1) 模型与量化：按 Hugging Face Open LLM Leaderboard 选取每个约 1B 参数档的最高排名指令微调模型，共 8 个（Qwen2-0.5B、Qwen2.5-1.5B、Phi-2、Qwen2.5-3B、OLMoE-1B-7B-0125(MoE)、Qwen2.5-7B、Meta-Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B）；用 llama-quantize 生成两种 GGUF 4-bit 格式——块状混合精度 Q4_K_M 与基于激活感知重要性/码本索引的 IQ4_XS。2) 平台：Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra (Android 16)，llama.cpp CPU-only，8 线程；主机为 MacBook Air M4 运行 Experiment Runner 编排；采用无线 ADB 避免充电电流污染放电式能耗测量。3) 测量管线：自研用户态 Android 应用调用原生 BatteryManager API，以 100 ms 采样记录电压、电流、温度与时间戳；空闲 2 小时测得基线功率做基线减法，按梯形积分得总焦耳；固定解码参数（温度 0 贪心、上下文 512、最大输出 100 token），每条件 30 次重复，运行间 200 s 冷却，电池电量维持 80%–100%，屏幕常亮最低亮度并隔离后台进程，逐次清空 logcat、回收输出与产物。4) 指标：prefill 速度、生成速度、TTFT、端到端延迟、峰值内存、总能耗与 J/token；质量用 BERTScore（参考式）与 G-Eval 式 LLM 评判（faithfulness/relevance/coherence，无参考式）。5) 统计：Shapiro–Wilk 检验显示非正态，故用 Friedman 总体检验 + 配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验（Holm–Bonferroni 校正）做多模型/量化排序。
AI.result: RQ1：0.5B–9B 全部模型均可无 OOM、无硬件故障运行，技术可行；但实用可行仅限 ≤3B，8B/9B 端到端延迟超 10 s，不适合实时助手。prefill 吞吐远高于 generation，所有配置下生成阶段（memory-bound 矩阵向量乘）主导总延迟与能耗；延迟随规模非线性上升，Gemma-2-9B 单次能耗常超 300 J，Qwen2-0.5B 约 50 J。RQ2：IQ4_XS 在峰值内存上以 p=2.82e-41 显著取胜，但 Q4_K_M 在生成速度 (p=0.00423)、总能耗 (p=3.36e-07)、延迟 (p=1.32e-26)、TTFT (p=2.24e-36) 上全部显著胜出——码本解包/运行时权重重建的分支与 cache 查找惩罚抵消了少传字节的收益。RQ3：稠密模型五项指标随参数量单调劣化，总能耗近似指数上升；OLMoE-1B-7B 生成速度与能耗排名均为第 2（与 1.5B/3B 紧密聚类），内存排名却为第 5，违背规模-能耗规律。质量侧，Gemma-2-9B 的 G-Eval 最优但最耗能；Qwen2.5-7B 质量优于 Llama-3.1-8B 而能耗更低；BERTScore 存在系统性偏置——偏好大段复制原文的抽取式输出，使小模型虚高、惩罚大模型的改写式抽象总结。速度与质量呈严格 Pareto 对立。
AI.conclusion: 结论：端侧推理的物理效率由架构与“每 token 活跃计算量”主导，而非压缩格式；IQ4_XS 一类重要性感知量化应被视为“容量使能器”（把大模型塞进 RAM），而非省电工具；MoE 通过稀疏路由解耦总参数量与活跃计算，在内存充足的旗舰机上提供 7B 级容量配 1~2B 级能耗，但需常驻全部专家，限制其在中小内存设备上的适用性。部署建议分层：追求顶级推理质量且内存/散热充裕可选 Gemma-2-9B（接受高延迟与快速耗电）；电池与即时性优先则只能选 0.5B–1.5B 蒸馏模型并接受质量损失；通用均衡场景推荐 3B 级稠密模型（Qwen2.5-3B）或 OLMoE 类稀疏架构作为最优甜点。方法学贡献为无需 Root、无需拆机的可复现端侧多目标剖析流程，并公开复制包。局限包括：单一旗舰机单案例、依赖 BatteryManager 软件遥测精度与采样率受限、任务仅为单一有界文档摘要（贪心解码、100 token 上限）、仅覆盖两种 4-bit 量化（未测 sub-4-bit、剪枝、蒸馏、投机解码）、环境与电池老化带来的残余噪声。未来工作：扩展至异构硬件（手机 GPU/NPU、不同价位段）与更多工作负载、量化格式与移动推理内核协同设计、以及热感知/电量感知的动态模型路由与降级策略，并探索完全原生（无主机侧 ADB）的端侧基准测试。

title: Constitutive parameterized deep energy method for solid mechanics problems with random material parameters
summary: In practical structural design and solid mechanics simulations, material properties inherently exhibit random variations within bounded intervals. However, evaluating mechanical responses under continuous material uncertainty remains a persistent challenge. Traditional numerical approaches, such as the Finite Element Method (FEM), incur prohibitive computational costs as they require repeated mesh discretization and equation solving for every parametric realization. Similarly, data-driven surrogate models depend heavily on massive, high-fidelity datasets, while standard physics-informed frameworks (e.g., the Deep Energy Method) strictly demand complete retraining from scratch whenever material parameters change. To bridge this critical gap, we propose the Constitutive Parameterized Deep Energy Method (CPDEM). In this purely physics-driven framework, the strain energy density functional is reformulated by encoding a latent representation of stochastic constitutive parameters. By embedding material parameters directly into the neural network alongside spatial coordinates, CPDEM transforms conventional spatial collocation points into parameter-aware material points. Trained in an unsupervised manner via expected energy minimization over the parameter domain, the pre-trained model continuously learns the solution manifold.
